```{r}
#| label: build-gk-payload
#| results: asis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qs2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(jsonlite)
})

data_dir <- "data"
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)

primary_gk_path  <- "C:/Users/iflem/Documents/Work/GK_App/data/master_gk_payload.qs2"
fallback_gk_path <- file.path(data_dir, "master_gk_payload.qs2")

if (file.exists(primary_gk_path)) {
  file.copy(primary_gk_path, fallback_gk_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  master_payload <- qs2::qs_read(primary_gk_path)
} else if (file.exists(fallback_gk_path)) {
  master_payload <- qs2::qs_read(fallback_gk_path)
} else {
  stop("master_gk_payload.qs2 not found.")
}

gk_mapping   <- master_payload$gk_mapping
shot_stream  <- master_payload$gk_shot_stream
gk_match_log <- master_payload$gk_match_log
gk_cq_splits <- master_payload$gk_cq_splits
model_meta   <- master_payload$model_meta

prior_sd_gp <- if (!is.null(model_meta$prior_sd_gp) && is.finite(model_meta$prior_sd_gp) && model_meta$prior_sd_gp > 0) {
  round(as.numeric(model_meta$prior_sd_gp), 6)
} else {
  0.036
}
tau_logit <- if (!is.null(model_meta$tau_logit) && is.finite(model_meta$tau_logit)) round(as.numeric(model_meta$tau_logit), 5) else NA_real_
scale_gp  <- if (!is.null(model_meta$scale_gp) && is.finite(model_meta$scale_gp)) round(as.numeric(model_meta$scale_gp), 5) else NA_real_
model_name <- if (!is.null(model_meta$model_name) && nzchar(model_meta$model_name)) as.character(model_meta$model_name) else "Static Empirical Bayes"

# Global reference baselines matching gk_app/app.R
global_cq_avgs <- gk_cq_splits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cq_bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_sv_pct = round(1 - (sum(goals_allowed, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(sum(shots_faced, na.rm = TRUE), 1)), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

global_gp_avg <- gk_match_log %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    avg_gp_10xgot = round((sum(match_gp, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(sum(match_xgot, na.rm = TRUE), 0.1)) * 10, 4),
    avg_axa_pct   = round((sum(match_gp > 0, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(dplyr::n(), 1)) * 100, 2)
  )

global_max_gp <- max(abs(gk_match_log$match_gp), na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.infinite(global_max_gp) || is.na(global_max_gp)) global_max_gp <- 3.0
global_max_gp <- round(global_max_gp, 3)

global_avg_xgot <- if (!is.null(model_meta$global_avg_xgot) && is.finite(model_meta$global_avg_xgot)) {
  round(as.numeric(model_meta$global_avg_xgot), 4)
} else {
  round(sum(gk_match_log$match_xgot, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(sum(gk_cq_splits$shots_faced, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 4)
}

# Pre-compute League-level CQ & GP benchmarks for O(1) lookup in SAVE Profile
keeper_leagues <- gk_mapping %>% dplyr::select(keeper_id, league_id) %>% dplyr::distinct()

league_cq_table <- gk_cq_splits %>%
  dplyr::left_join(keeper_leagues, by = "keeper_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(league_id)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(league_id, cq_bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    shots = sum(shots_faced, na.rm = TRUE),
    goals = sum(goals_allowed, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

league_gp_table <- gk_match_log %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(league_id)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(league_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sum_gp   = round(sum(match_gp, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sum_xgot = round(sum(match_xgot, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    pos_cnt  = sum(match_gp > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    tot_cnt  = dplyr::n(),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

# Retain every shot (up to 300 frames per keeper) so the slider steps through consecutive 1, 2, 3... shot numbers
stream_anim <- shot_stream %>%
  dplyr::group_by(keeper_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice(unique(round(seq(1, dplyr::n(), length.out = min(dplyr::n(), 300))))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

if (!"formatted_date" %in% names(stream_anim)) stream_anim$formatted_date <- NA_character_
if (!"cum_xgot" %in% names(stream_anim)) stream_anim$cum_xgot <- NA_real_

stream_anim <- stream_anim %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    date_str = dplyr::coalesce(as.character(formatted_date), stringr::str_match(stat_label, "<b>Date:</b> (.*?)<br>")[, 2], "Unknown Date"),
    cum_xgot = round(dplyr::coalesce(as.numeric(cum_xgot), as.numeric(stringr::str_match(stat_label, "<b>Expected Goals \\(xGOT\\):</b> ([0-9.]+)")[, 2])), 2),
    post_mu  = round(post_mu, 4),
    post_sd  = round(post_sd, 4),
    cum_gp   = round(cum_goals_prevented, 2)
  )

stream_by_gk <- split(
  stream_anim %>% dplyr::select(s = shot_num, m = post_mu, sd = post_sd, gp = cum_gp, x = cum_xgot, d = date_str),
  stream_anim$keeper_id
)
stream_by_gk <- lapply(stream_by_gk, function(df) {
  list(s = df$s, m = df$m, sd = df$sd, gp = df$gp, x = df$x, d = df$d)
})

matches_clean <- gk_match_log %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    keeper_id = keeper_id,
    d  = as.character(match_date),
    df = ifelse(is.na(match_date), "Unknown Date", format(as.Date(match_date), "%b %d, %Y")),
    x  = round(match_xgot, 2),
    g  = as.integer(match_goals),
    gp = round(match_gp, 2)
  )
matches_by_gk <- split(matches_clean %>% dplyr::select(-keeper_id), matches_clean$keeper_id)
matches_by_gk <- lapply(matches_by_gk, function(df) {
  list(d = df$d, df = df$df, x = df$x, g = df$g, gp = df$gp)
})

cq_clean <- gk_cq_splits %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    keeper_id = keeper_id,
    b  = as.character(cq_bin),
    sf = as.integer(shots_faced),
    ga = as.integer(goals_allowed),
    sv = round(sv_pct, 4)
  )
cq_by_gk <- split(cq_clean %>% dplyr::select(-keeper_id), cq_clean$keeper_id)

mapping_clean <- gk_mapping %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    keeper_id     = as.character(keeper_id),
    league_id     = as.numeric(league_id),
    player_name   = as.character(player_name),
    team_name     = as.character(team_name),
    age           = ifelse(is.na(age), NA_real_, round(as.numeric(age))),
    total_minutes = round(as.numeric(total_minutes))
  )

payload <- list(
  globals = list(
    cq_avgs    = global_cq_avgs,
    gp_avg     = global_gp_avg,
    max_gp     = global_max_gp,
    avg_xgot   = global_avg_xgot,
    prior_sd   = prior_sd_gp
  ),
  model_meta = list(
    model_name  = model_name,
    prior_sd_gp = prior_sd_gp,
    tau_logit   = tau_logit,
    scale_gp    = scale_gp
  ),
  league_cq = league_cq_table,
  league_gp = league_gp_table,
  mapping   = mapping_clean,
  stream    = stream_by_gk,
  matches   = matches_by_gk,
  cq        = cq_by_gk
)

cat(sprintf(
  "\n```{=html}\n<script id=\"gk-app-payload\" type=\"application/json\">%s</script>\n```\n",
  jsonlite::toJSON(payload, dataframe = "columns", auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

    color: #1D3549;

    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Canvas Card Stage */
  .gk-canvas-stage {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .gk-card-canvas {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 6px;
    border: 1px solid #D6DDE5;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(15, 30, 44, 0.08);
    cursor: crosshair;
  }

  .gk-post-canvas {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    display: block;
    cursor: crosshair;
  }

  .gk-canvas-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: none;
    background-color: rgba(15, 30, 44, 0.94);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    padding: 0.48rem 0.68rem;
    border-radius: 5px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
    z-index: 40;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  .gk-stage-bar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
  }

  .gk-stage-hint {
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    color: #64748B;
  }

  /* Interactive Match Log Companion Drawer below SAVE Card */
  .gk-companion-box {
    max-width: 1180px;
    margin: 1.15rem auto 0 auto;
    border: 1px solid #DEE2E6;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .gk-companion-header {
    background-color: #F8F9FA;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #DEE2E6;
    padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .gk-companion-title {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #1D3549;
  }

  .gk-companion-toggle {
    border: 1px solid #CED4DA;
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    color: #1D3549;
    font-family: 'Assistant', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .gk-companion-toggle:hover {
    border-color: #00747A;
    color: #00747A;
  }

  .gk-match-table-wrap {
    max-height: 310px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    width: 100%;
  }

  table.gk-match-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 0.86rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  table.gk-match-table th {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    background-color: #F8F9FA;
    color: #334155;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-align: left;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #DEE2E6;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  table.gk-match-table th.num,
  table.gk-match-table td.num {
    text-align: right;
  }

  table.gk-match-table td {
    padding: 0.44rem 0.85rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #EDF0F2;
    color: #1E293B;

  table.gk-match-table tbody tr:hover {
    background-color: #F4F9FA;

  .gk-val-pos {
    color: #00747A;

    "Newcastle Jets": { logo: "logos/fm_675729.png", color: "#024C91" },
    "North Carolina Courage": { logo: "logos/fm_243295.png", color: "#9C8446" },
    "OL Lyonnes": { logo: "logos/fm_394119.png", color: "#0E3C75" },
    "Orlando Pride": { logo: "logos/fm_728922.png", color: "#61259E" },
    "Paris FC": { logo: "logos/fm_862893.png", color: "#0F1626" },
    "Paris Saint Germain": { logo: "logos/fm_294858.png", color: "#004170" },
    "Paris Saint-Germain": { logo: "logos/fm_294858.png", color: "#004170" },
    "Perth Glory": { logo: "logos/fm_675730.png", color: "#5D2881" },
    "Portland Thorns": { logo: "logos/fm_433029.png", color: "#99242B" },
    "Racing Louisville": { logo: "logos/fm_1237244.png", color: "#6B4C9A" },
    "Saint Malo": { logo: "logos/fm_1863827.png", color: "#004B87" },
    "San Diego Wave FC": { logo: "logos/fm_1335917.png", color: "#D6246E" },
    "Seattle Reign FC": { logo: "logos/fm_433031.png", color: "#2D476E" },
    "Sporting Jacksonville": { logo: "logos/sofa_1077193.png", color: "#0082B3" },
    "Sporting JAX": { logo: "logos/sofa_1077193.png", color: "#0082B3" },
    "Strasbourg": { logo: "logos/fm_1661333.png", color: "#005CA9" },
    "Sydney FC": { logo: "logos/fm_675731.png", color: "#2B74A8" },
    "Tampa Bay Sun FC": { logo: "logos/sofa_1112821.png", color: "#C69214" },
    "Tottenham Hotspur": { logo: "logos/fm_628117.png", color: "#132257" },
    "Toulouse": { logo: "logos/fm_1863810.png", color: "#51267D" },
    "Utah Royals": { logo: "logos/fm_923654.png", color: "#D49B1A" },
    "Washington Spirit": { logo: "logos/fm_433030.png", color: "#1C2D42" },
    "Wellington Phoenix": { logo: "logos/fm_1300347.png", color: "#C69214" },
    "West Ham United": { logo: "logos/fm_231497.png", color: "#7A263A" },
    "Western Sydney Wanderers FC": { logo: "logos/fm_675732.png", color: "#C60C30" }
  };

  const rawPayload = document.getElementById("gk-app-payload").textContent;
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawPayload);

  function normSearch(str) {
    return String(str || "")
      .normalize("NFD")
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
      .toLowerCase();
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str ?? "")
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
      .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
      .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
      .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
  }

  function toArr(v) {
    if (v === undefined || v === null) return [];
    return Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v];
  }

  function formatSigned(val, digits) {
    const n = Number(val);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return "\u2014";
    return (n >= 0 ? "+" : "\u2212") + Math.abs(n).toFixed(digits);
  }

  function plural(n, singular, pluralWord) {
    return n === 1 ? singular : (pluralWord || singular + "s");
  }

  function getOrdinalSuffix(n) {
    const v = Math.round(Number(n));
    const mod100 = v % 100;
    if (mod100 >= 11 && mod100 <= 13) return v + "th";
    const mod10 = v % 10;
    if (mod10 === 1) return v + "st";
    if (mod10 === 2) return v + "nd";
    if (mod10 === 3) return v + "rd";
    return v + "th";
  }

  function ecdfPercentile(vals, target) {
    if (!vals || vals.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(target)) return 50;
    let le = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vals.length; i++) {
      if (vals[i] <= target) le++;
    }
    const raw = (le / vals.length) * 100.0;
    return Math.max(1, Math.min(99, Math.round(raw)));
  }

  function slugify(str) {
    return normSearch(str).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_").replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "") || "goalkeeper";
  }

  function colsToRows(colObj) {
    if (!colObj) return [];
    const keys = Object.keys(colObj);
    if (keys.length === 0) return [];
    const n = Array.isArray(colObj[keys[0]]) ? colObj[keys[0]].length : 1;
    const rows = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const r = {};
      for (let k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
        const key = keys[k];
        r[key] = Array.isArray(colObj[key]) ? colObj[key][i] : colObj[key];
      }
      rows[i] = r;
    }
    return rows;
  }

  const mappingRows  = colsToRows(payload.mapping);
  const leagueCqRows = colsToRows(payload.league_cq);
  const leagueGpRows = colsToRows(payload.league_gp);
  const globalCqRows = colsToRows(payload.globals.cq_avgs);
  const globalGpRow  = colsToRows(payload.globals.gp_avg)[0] || { avg_gp_10xgot: 0, avg_axa_pct: 50 };
  const globalAvgXgot = Number(payload.globals.avg_xgot) || 0.27;
  const rawPriorSd   = Number(payload.model_meta?.prior_sd_gp ?? payload.globals?.prior_sd ?? 0.036);
  const PRIOR_SD     = (Number.isFinite(rawPriorSd) && rawPriorSd > 0) ? rawPriorSd : 0.036;
  const modelName    = String(payload.model_meta?.model_name || "Empirical Bayes");
  const baselineLabel = /Calibrated/i.test(modelName)
    ? "Calibrated xG Model Baseline"
    : "Global xG Model Baseline";

  const streamMap  = payload.stream || {};
  const matchesMap = payload.matches || {};
  const cqMap      = payload.cq || {};

  // Normal PDF & CDF
  const INV_SQRT_2PI = 1 / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI);
  function dnorm(x, mu, sd) {
    const z = (x - mu) / sd;
    return (INV_SQRT_2PI / sd) * Math.exp(-0.5 * z * z);
  }

  function pnorm(x, mu, sd) {
    const z = (x - mu) / (sd * Math.SQRT2);
    const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * Math.abs(z));
    const a1 = 0.254829592, a2 = -0.284496736, a3 = 1.421413741, a4 = -1.453152027, a5 = 1.061405429;
    const erf = 1 - (((((a5 * t + a4) * t) + a3) * t + a2) * t + a1) * t * Math.exp(-z * z);
    const sign = z < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    return 0.5 * (1 + sign * erf);
  }

  // Hydrate unified per-keeper summary index (runs once in <15ms)
  const keeperById = new Map();
  const keepersByLeague = new Map();

  for (let i = 0; i < mappingRows.length; i++) {
    const row = mappingRows[i];
    const kid = String(row.keeper_id);
    const lid = Number(row.league_id);
    if (!keeperById.has(kid)) {
      const st = streamMap[kid] || {};
      const ml = matchesMap[kid] || {};
      const cq = cqMap[kid] || {};

      const sArr  = toArr(st.s).map(Number);
      const muArr = toArr(st.m).map(Number);
      const sdArr = toArr(st.sd).map(Number);
      const gpArr = toArr(st.gp).map(Number);

      const finalIdx = Math.max(0, sArr.length - 1);
      const mu = sArr.length ? muArr[finalIdx] : 0;
      const sd = sArr.length ? sdArr[finalIdx] : PRIOR_SD;

      const cqBins = toArr(cq.b);
      const cqSf   = toArr(cq.sf).map(Number);
      const cqGa   = toArr(cq.ga).map(Number);
      const cqSv   = toArr(cq.sv).map(Number);

      const getSplit = (bin) => {
        const idx = cqBins.indexOf(bin);
        return idx >= 0 ? { sf: cqSf[idx] || 0, ga: cqGa[idx] || 0, sv: cqSv[idx] || 0 } : { sf: 0, ga: 0, sv: 0 };
      };
      const low  = getSplit("Low");
      const med  = getSplit("Medium");
      const high = getSplit("High");

      const totalShots = low.sf + med.sf + high.sf;
      const goalsAllowed = low.ga + med.ga + high.ga;

      const rawDates = toArr(ml.d);
      const rawFmt   = toArr(ml.df);
      const rawX     = toArr(ml.x).map(Number);
      const rawG     = toArr(ml.g).map(Number);
      const rawGp    = toArr(ml.gp).map(Number);
      const matchRows = [];
      for (let m = 0; m < rawGp.length; m++) {
        matchRows.push({
          idx: m,
          d: rawDates[m] ? String(rawDates[m]) : null,
          df: rawFmt[m] ? String(rawFmt[m]) : "Unknown Date",
          x: Number.isFinite(rawX[m]) ? rawX[m] : 0,
          g: Number.isFinite(rawG[m]) ? rawG[m] : 0,
          gp: Number.isFinite(rawGp[m]) ? rawGp[m] : 0
        });
      }
      matchRows.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.d && b.d) return a.d < b.d ? -1 : (a.d > b.d ? 1 : a.idx - b.idx);
        if (a.d && !b.d) return -1;
        if (!a.d && b.d) return 1;
        return a.idx - b.idx;
      });
      let runGp = 0;
      for (let m = 0; m < matchRows.length; m++) {
        runGp += matchRows[m].gp;
        matchRows[m].cumGp = runGp;
      }

      const totalXgot = rawX.reduce((a, b) => a + (Number.isFinite(b) ? b : 0), 0);
      const totalGp   = sArr.length ? gpArr[finalIdx] : matchRows.reduce((a, b) => a + b.gp, 0);
      const totalMins = Number(row.total_minutes) || 0;
      const ageNum    = (row.age !== null && row.age !== undefined && row.age !== "NA" && !isNaN(Number(row.age)))
        ? Math.round(Number(row.age)) : null;

      const nMatches   = matchRows.length;
      const posMatches = matchRows.filter(m => m.gp > 0).length;
      const cleanSheets = matchRows.filter(m => m.g === 0).length;
      const axaPct     = nMatches > 0 ? (posMatches / nMatches) * 100 : 0;
      const gp10Xgot   = totalXgot > 0.05 ? (totalGp / totalXgot) * 10 : 0;

      const pAboveAvg  = (1 - pnorm(0, mu, Math.max(sd, 1e-6))) * 100;
      const certaintyPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(99, (1 - (sd * sd) / (PRIOR_SD * PRIOR_SD)) * 100));

      const svPct  = totalShots > 0 ? ((totalShots - goalsAllowed) / totalShots) * 100 : 0;
      const xSvPct = totalShots > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (1 - totalXgot / totalShots) * 100)) : 0;
      const avgShotXgot = totalShots > 0 ? totalXgot / totalShots : 0;

      keeperById.set(kid, {
        keeper_id: kid,
        player_name: String(row.player_name || "Goalkeeper"),
        team_name: String(row.team_name || "Unknown Club"),
        _norm: normSearch((row.player_name || "") + " " + (row.team_name || "")),
        age: ageNum,
        total_minutes: totalMins,
        qualified: totalMins >= QUAL_MIN_MINS,
        leagues: [],
        primary_league_id: lid,
        mu,
        sd,
        ci_low: mu - 1.96 * sd,
        ci_high: mu + 1.96 * sd,
        p_above_avg: pAboveAvg,
        certainty_pct: certaintyPct,
        shots_faced: sArr.length ? sArr[finalIdx] : totalShots,
        total_shots: totalShots,
        goals_allowed: goalsAllowed,
        total_xgot: totalXgot,
        total_gp: totalGp,
        gp_10xgot: gp10Xgot,
        axa_pct: axaPct,
        pos_matches: posMatches,
        clean_sheets: cleanSheets,
        n_matches: nMatches,
        sv_pct: svPct,
        x_sv_pct: xSvPct,
        avg_shot_xgot: avgShotXgot,
        cq_low: low,
        cq_med: med,
        cq_high: high,
        matches: matchRows
      });
    }
    const kObj = keeperById.get(kid);
    if (!kObj.leagues.includes(lid)) kObj.leagues.push(lid);
    if (!keepersByLeague.has(lid)) keepersByLeague.set(lid, []);
    if (!keepersByLeague.get(lid).some(x => x.keeper_id === kid)) {
      keepersByLeague.get(lid).push(kObj);
    }
  }

  // Resolve primary domestic league for each keeper
  keeperById.forEach(k => {
    let chosen = k.leagues[0];
    for (let p = 0; p < DOMESTIC_PRIORITY.length; p++) {
      if (k.leagues.includes(DOMESTIC_PRIORITY[p])) {
        chosen = DOMESTIC_PRIORITY[p];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!DOMESTIC_PRIORITY.includes(chosen)) {
      const nonIntl = k.leagues.find(l => !INTL_SET.has(l) && l !== 696);
      if (nonIntl !== undefined) chosen = nonIntl;
    }
    k.primary_league_id = chosen;
  });

  const allKeepersList = Array.from(keeperById.values()).sort((a, b) => a.player_name.localeCompare(b.player_name));

  document.getElementById("gk_model_badge").textContent =
    `${modelName} \u2022 ${allKeepersList.length.toLocaleString("en-US")} Keepers`;

  function getFilteredKeepers(leagueFilterVal) {
    let list;
    if (leagueFilterVal === "all") {
      list = allKeepersList.slice();
    } else if (leagueFilterVal === "intl") {
      const seen = new Set();
      list = [];
      INTL_SET.forEach(lid => {
        (keepersByLeague.get(lid) || []).forEach(k => {
          if (!seen.has(k.keeper_id)) { seen.add(k.keeper_id); list.push(k); }
        });
      });
      list.sort((a, b) => a.player_name.localeCompare(b.player_name));
    } else {
      list = (keepersByLeague.get(Number(leagueFilterVal)) || []).slice()
        .sort((a, b) => a.player_name.localeCompare(b.player_name));
    }
    return list;
  }

  function getQualifiedCohort(leagueFilterVal) {
    const base = getFilteredKeepers(leagueFilterVal);
    let qual = base.filter(k => k.qualified);
    if (qual.length === 0) qual = base.slice();
    qual.sort((a, b) => (b.mu - a.mu) || (a.sd - b.sd));
    return qual;
  }

  function pickDefaultKeeperId(leagueFilterVal, offset = 0) {
    const qual = getQualifiedCohort(leagueFilterVal);
    if (qual.length === 0) return "";
    return qual[Math.min(offset, qual.length - 1)].keeper_id;
  }

  function getBenchmarkInfo(keeper, leagueFilterVal, benchMode) {
    let activeLgVal = leagueFilterVal;
    if (benchMode === "global") {
      activeLgVal = "all";
    } else if (leagueFilterVal === "all") {
      activeLgVal = String(keeper.primary_league_id);
    }

    const lgLabel = LEAGUE_SHORT_BY_ID[String(activeLgVal)] ||
      (INTL_SET.has(Number(activeLgVal)) ? "Senior Intl" : "League");

    const cohortAll = getFilteredKeepers(activeLgVal);
    const qualCohort = cohortAll.filter(k => k.qualified).sort((a, b) => (b.mu - a.mu) || (a.sd - b.sd));
    const rankCohort = qualCohort.length > 0 ? qualCohort : cohortAll.slice().sort((a, b) => (b.mu - a.mu) || (a.sd - b.sd));
    const rankIdx = rankCohort.findIndex(k => k.keeper_id === keeper.keeper_id);
    const pctl = ecdfPercentile(rankCohort.map(k => k.mu), keeper.mu);
    const gp10Pctl = ecdfPercentile(rankCohort.map(k => k.gp_10xgot), keeper.gp_10xgot);
    const axaPctl  = ecdfPercentile(rankCohort.map(k => k.axa_pct), keeper.axa_pct);

    const isTargetLeague = (lid) => {
      const nLid = Number(lid);
      if (activeLgVal === "intl") return INTL_SET.has(nLid);
      if (activeLgVal !== "all") return nLid === Number(activeLgVal);
      return true;
    };

    const glCqMap = {};
    globalCqRows.forEach(r => { glCqMap[r.cq_bin] = Number(r.avg_sv_pct) * 100; });

    const lgCqAvg = {};
    ["Low", "Medium", "High"].forEach(bin => {
      if (activeLgVal === "all") {
        lgCqAvg[bin] = glCqMap[bin] ?? 50;
      } else {
        let shots = 0, goals = 0;
        leagueCqRows.forEach(r => {
          if (r.cq_bin === bin && isTargetLeague(r.league_id)) {
            shots += Number(r.shots);
            goals += Number(r.goals);
          }
        });
        lgCqAvg[bin] = shots > 0 ? (1 - goals / shots) * 100 : (glCqMap[bin] ?? 50);
      }
    });

    let lgGp10 = Number(globalGpRow.avg_gp_10xgot) || 0;
    let lgAxa  = Number(globalGpRow.avg_axa_pct) || 50;
    if (activeLgVal !== "all") {
      let sGp = 0, sX = 0, sPos = 0, sTot = 0;
      leagueGpRows.forEach(r => {
        if (isTargetLeague(r.league_id)) {
          sGp += Number(r.sum_gp);
          sX  += Number(r.sum_xgot);
          sPos += Number(r.pos_cnt);
          sTot += Number(r.tot_cnt);
        }
      });
      if (sTot > 0) {
        lgGp10 = (sGp / Math.max(sX, 0.1)) * 10;
        lgAxa  = (sPos / sTot) * 100;
      }
    }

    return {
      activeLgVal,
      cohortLabel: activeLgVal === "all" ? "Global" : lgLabel,
      cohortSize: rankCohort.length,
      rank: rankIdx >= 0 ? rankIdx + 1 : null,
      qualified: keeper.qualified,
      pctl,
      gp10Pctl,
      axaPctl,
      lgCqAvg,
      glCqAvg: glCqMap,
      lgGp10,
      lgAxa
    };
  }

  // Logo cache for safe same-origin Canvas rendering
  const logoImageCache = new Map();

  function resolveClubBadge(teamName) {
    if (CLUB_BADGES[teamName]) return CLUB_BADGES[teamName];
    const norm = normSearch(teamName);
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(CLUB_BADGES)) {
      if (normSearch(key) === norm) return val;
    }
    return { logo: null, color: "#00747A" };
  }

  function getLoadedLogo(logoPath, onReady) {
    if (!logoPath) return null;
    const entry = logoImageCache.get(logoPath);
    if (entry) {
      if (entry.status === "loaded") return entry.img;
      if (entry.status === "loading" && onReady) entry.waiters.push(onReady);
      return null;
    }
    const img = new Image();
    const rec = { status: "loading", img, waiters: onReady ? [onReady] : [] };
    logoImageCache.set(logoPath, rec);
    img.onload = () => {
      rec.status = "loaded";
      const ws = rec.waiters.slice();
      rec.waiters.length = 0;
      ws.forEach(fn => fn());
    };
    img.onerror = () => {
      rec.status = "error";
      rec.waiters.length = 0;
    };
    img.src = logoPath;
    return null;
  }

  let fontsPromise = null;
  function ensureFonts() {
    if (!fontsPromise) {
      const waitFonts = (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready)
        ? Promise.all([
            document.fonts.load("800 60px Assistant").catch(() => {}),
            document.fonts.load("700 32px Assistant").catch(() => {}),
            document.fonts.load("600 22px Assistant").catch(() => {}),
            document.fonts.ready
          ])
        : Promise.resolve();
      const timeout = new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 1200));
      fontsPromise = Promise.race([waitFonts, timeout]);
    }
    return fontsPromise;
  }

  function populateLeagueSelect(selectId, defaultVal = "9134") {
    const sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
    sel.innerHTML = "";
    LEAGUE_CHOICES.forEach(ch => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = ch.value;
      opt.textContent = ch.label;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
    sel.value = defaultVal;
  }

  // Searchable combobox
  const comboRegistry = {};

  function setupSearchableCombo(baseId, onSelectCallback) {
    const hiddenEl = document.getElementById(baseId);
    const inputEl  = document.getElementById(baseId + "_search");
    const menuEl   = document.getElementById(baseId + "_menu");
    const wrapEl   = document.getElementById("wrap_" + baseId);

    const state = {
      items: [],
      filtered: [],
      selectedId: "",
      selectedLabel: "",
      highlightIdx: 0
    };

    function renderMenu(queryStr) {
      const q = normSearch(queryStr).trim();
      state.filtered = q
        ? state.items.filter(k => k._norm.includes(q))
        : state.items;

      menuEl.innerHTML = "";
      if (state.filtered.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement("div");
        empty.className = "gk-search-empty";
        empty.textContent = "No matching goalkeepers";
        menuEl.appendChild(empty);
        return;
      }

      state.highlightIdx = Math.max(0, state.filtered.findIndex(k => k.keeper_id === state.selectedId));
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      state.filtered.forEach((k, idx) => {
        const div = document.createElement("div");
        div.className = "gk-search-option" + (idx === state.highlightIdx ? " active" : "");
        const nSpan = document.createElement("span");
        nSpan.className = "gk-search-option-name";
        nSpan.textContent = k.player_name;
        const sSpan = document.createElement("span");
        sSpan.className = "gk-search-option-sub";
        sSpan.textContent = k.team_name;
        div.appendChild(nSpan);
        div.appendChild(sSpan);
        div.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          selectKeeper(k.keeper_id, k.player_name, true);
          closeMenu();
        });
        frag.appendChild(div);
      });
      menuEl.appendChild(frag);

      const activeNode = menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx];
      if (activeNode) activeNode.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    }

    function selectKeeper(id, name, triggerCallback) {
      state.selectedId = String(id || "");
      state.selectedLabel = String(name || "");
      hiddenEl.value = state.selectedId;
      inputEl.value = state.selectedLabel;
      if (triggerCallback && onSelectCallback) onSelectCallback(state.selectedId);
    }

    function openMenu() {
      Object.keys(comboRegistry).forEach(k => {
        if (k !== baseId) comboRegistry[k].closeMenu();
      });
      inputEl.value = "";
      renderMenu("");
      menuEl.classList.add("open");
    }

    function closeMenu() {
      menuEl.classList.remove("open");
      inputEl.value = state.selectedLabel;
    }

    inputEl.addEventListener("focus", openMenu);
    inputEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) openMenu();
    });
    inputEl.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) menuEl.classList.add("open");
      renderMenu(inputEl.value);
    });
    inputEl.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (!menuEl.classList.contains("open")) return;
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.filtered.length > 0) {
          state.highlightIdx = Math.min(state.highlightIdx + 1, state.filtered.length - 1);
          Array.from(menuEl.children).forEach((c, i) => c.classList.toggle("active", i === state.highlightIdx));
          if (menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx]) menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
        }
      } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.filtered.length > 0) {
          state.highlightIdx = Math.max(state.highlightIdx - 1, 0);
          Array.from(menuEl.children).forEach((c, i) => c.classList.toggle("active", i === state.highlightIdx));
          if (menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx]) menuEl.children[state.highlightIdx].scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
        }
      } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
        e.preventDefault();
        const picked = state.filtered[state.highlightIdx];
        if (picked) {
          selectKeeper(picked.keeper_id, picked.player_name, true);
          closeMenu();
          inputEl.blur();
        }
      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
        closeMenu();
        inputEl.blur();
      }
    });

    wrapEl.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.stopPropagation());

    comboRegistry[baseId] = {
      setItems(keepers, preferredId, defaultIdx = 0) {
        state.items = keepers;
        const pref = preferredId ? keepers.find(k => k.keeper_id === preferredId) : null;
        if (pref) {
          selectKeeper(pref.keeper_id, pref.player_name, false);
          return;
        }
        const existing = keepers.find(k => k.keeper_id === state.selectedId);
        if (existing) {
          selectKeeper(existing.keeper_id, existing.player_name, false);
        } else if (keepers.length > 0) {
          const idx = Math.min(defaultIdx || 0, keepers.length - 1);
          selectKeeper(keepers[idx].keeper_id, keepers[idx].player_name, false);
        } else {
          selectKeeper("", "", false);
        }
      },
      setSelected(kid) {
        const hit = state.items.find(k => k.keeper_id === kid);
        if (hit) selectKeeper(hit.keeper_id, hit.player_name, false);
      },
      closeMenu
    };
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", () => {
    Object.keys(comboRegistry).forEach(k => comboRegistry[k].closeMenu());
  });

  function renderTopList(containerId, leagueVal, activeKeeperId, onPick) {
    const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!el) return;
    const top = getQualifiedCohort(leagueVal).slice(0, 5);
    el.innerHTML = "";
    top.forEach((k, idx) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "gk-top-item" + (k.keeper_id === activeKeeperId ? " active" : "");
      btn.innerHTML = `
        <span class="gk-top-rank">#${idx + 1}</span>
        <span class="gk-top-name">${escapeHtml(k.player_name)}<span class="gk-top-sub">${escapeHtml(k.team_name)} &bull; ${k.shots_faced} sh</span></span>
        <span class="gk-top-val ${k.mu < 0 ? "neg" : ""}">${formatSigned(k.mu, 3)}</span>
      `;
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => onPick(k.keeper_id));
      el.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // SHARED CANVAS PRIMITIVES
  // =========================================================================
  const THEMES = {
    light: {
      bg: "#F5F7FA",
      cardBg: "#FFFFFF",
      cardBorder: "#D9E1EA",
      subBg: "#F8FAFC",
      crestPlate: "#F4F6F9",
      crestBorder: "#D9E1EA",
      ink: "#0F1E2C",
      inkSub: "#4B5C6E",
      inkMuted: "#738496",
      rule: "#E3E9F0",
      ruleStrong: "#1D3549",
      teal: "#00747A",
      crimson: "#B83A3A",
      priorStroke: "#7B8C9E",
      priorFill: "rgba(123, 140, 158, 0.11)",
      trackBg: "#E9EEF4",
      needle: "#1D3549",
      pillBg: "#EFF5F8",
      pillBorder: "#CBD8E4",
      dietHigh: "#C44536",
      dietMed: "#E09F3E",
      dietLow: "#5E86A8"
    },
    dark: {
      bg: "#0E1B26",
      cardBg: "#152635",
      cardBorder: "#273F54",
      subBg: "#1A2E40",
      crestPlate: "#EDF2F7",
      crestBorder: "#3A556E",
      ink: "#F4F5EF",
      inkSub: "#ADC0D1",
      inkMuted: "#7D95AA",
      rule: "#263D52",
      ruleStrong: "#35536E",
      teal: "#20B2AA",
      crimson: "#E26A5A",
      priorStroke: "#839BB0",
      priorFill: "rgba(131, 155, 176, 0.12)",
      trackBg: "#1F3549",
      needle: "#EEEDCE",
      pillBg: "#1B3144",
      pillBorder: "#2E4A63",
      dietHigh: "#DF6A58",
      dietMed: "#E4A749",
      dietLow: "#5C8DB8"
    }
  };

  function roundRectPath(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
    const rad = Math.min(r, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + rad, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - rad, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + rad);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - rad);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - rad, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + rad, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - rad);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + rad);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + rad, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lw = 2) {
    roundRectPath(ctx, x, y, w, h, r);
    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
    if (stroke) { ctx.lineWidth = lw; ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.stroke(); }
  }

  function fitTextFont(ctx, text, maxW, weight, startPx, minPx, family = "Assistant, sans-serif") {
    let px = startPx;
    while (px > minPx) {
      ctx.font = `${weight} ${px}px ${family}`;
      if (ctx.measureText(text).width <= maxW) break;
      px -= 2;
    }
    ctx.font = `${weight} ${px}px ${family}`;
    return px;
  }

  function truncateText(ctx, text, maxW) {
    if (ctx.measureText(text).width <= maxW) return text;
    let t = text;
    while (t.length > 2 && ctx.measureText(t + "\u2026").width > maxW) {
      t = t.slice(0, -1);
    }
    return t + "\u2026";
  }

  function clubInitials(teamName) {
    const words = String(teamName || "GK")
      .replace(/\b(FC|WFC|AFC|SC|CF|W\.F\.C\.)\b/gi, "")
      .trim()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter(Boolean);
    if (words.length >= 2) return (words[0][0] + words[1][0]).toUpperCase();
    if (words.length === 1) return words[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    return "GK";
  }

  function drawClubCrest(ctx, teamName, cx, cy, size, theme, onImageLoaded) {
    const badge = resolveClubBadge(teamName);
    const half = size * 0.5;
    const img = badge.logo ? getLoadedLogo(badge.logo, onImageLoaded) : null;
    if (img && img.naturalWidth > 0 && img.naturalHeight > 0) {
      // Crisp light neutral crest plate so dark club badges remain legible in Midnight Navy mode
      fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, cx - half, cy - half, size, size, 16, theme.crestPlate, theme.crestBorder, 2);
      const pad = size * 0.13;
      const box = size - pad * 2;
      const ratio = Math.min(box / img.naturalWidth, box / img.naturalHeight);
      const dw = img.naturalWidth * ratio;
      const dh = img.naturalHeight * ratio;
      ctx.drawImage(img, cx - dw * 0.5, cy - dh * 0.5, dw, dh);
      return badge.color;
    }

    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, cx - half, cy - half, size, size, 16, theme.subBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);
    ctx.save();
    const sw = size * 0.62;
    const sh = size * 0.68;
    const sx = cx - sw * 0.5;
    const sy = cy - sh * 0.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, sy + 6);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + sw, sy + 6);
    ctx.lineTo(sx + sw, sy + sh * 0.58);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx + sw, sy + sh * 0.88, cx, sy + sh);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sx, sy + sh * 0.88, sx, sy + sh * 0.58);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = badge.color || "#1D3549";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.cardBorder;
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.font = `800 ${Math.round(size * 0.29)}px Assistant, sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(clubInitials(teamName), cx, cy + 1);
    ctx.restore();
    return badge.color;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // TAB 1: SHOTSTOPPING POSTERIOR (NATIVE HIGH-DPI 60FPS CANVAS + LIVE HUD)
  // =========================================================================
  const postAnimState = {
    keeper: null,
    frames: [],
    frameIdx: 0,
    rafId: null,
    lastTick: 0,
    stepMs: 24,
    yLimit: 15,
    plotMeta: null
  };

  function stopPostAnim() {
    if (postAnimState.rafId !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(postAnimState.rafId);
      postAnimState.rafId = null;
    }
  }

  function updatePostHud(fIdx) {
    const f = postAnimState.frames[fIdx];
    if (!f) return;
    const totalShots = postAnimState.frames[postAnimState.frames.length - 1].s;

    document.getElementById("hud_shots").textContent = `Shot ${f.s} of ${totalShots}`;
    document.getElementById("hud_date").textContent = f.d || "Unknown Date";

    const gpEl = document.getElementById("hud_gp");
    gpEl.textContent = formatSigned(f.gp, 2);
    gpEl.style.color = f.gp >= 0 ? "#00747A" : "#B83A3A";
    const avgQ = f.x / Math.max(f.s, 1);
    document.getElementById("hud_xgot").textContent = `${f.x.toFixed(2)} xGOT (${avgQ.toFixed(2)}/shot)`;

    const muEl = document.getElementById("hud_mu");
    muEl.textContent = `${formatSigned(f.mu, 3)} GP/sh`;
    muEl.style.color = f.mu >= 0 ? "#00747A" : "#B83A3A";
    document.getElementById("hud_ci").textContent =
      `${formatSigned(f.mu * 100, 1)}/100 sh \u2022 95% CI [${formatSigned(f.ciLo, 3)}, ${formatSigned(f.ciHi, 3)}]`;

    const probEl = document.getElementById("hud_prob");
    probEl.textContent = `${f.pAbove.toFixed(1)}% Above Avg`;
    probEl.style.color = f.pAbove >= 60 ? "#00747A" : (f.pAbove <= 40 ? "#B83A3A" : "#1D3549");
    document.getElementById("hud_cert").textContent = `Sample Certainty: ${Math.round(f.cert)}%`;

    const scrub = document.getElementById("post_scrub_range");
    scrub.value = String(fIdx);
    document.getElementById("post_scrub_readout").textContent = `Shot ${f.s} (${f.d})`;
  }

  function drawPosteriorFrameCanvas(fIdx) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById("gk_posterior_canvas");
    const k = postAnimState.keeper;
    const f = postAnimState.frames[fIdx];
    if (!canvas || !k || !f) return;

    postAnimState.frameIdx = fIdx;
    updatePostHud(fIdx);

    const W = 1800, H = 900;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const theme = THEMES.light;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Header
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "800 34px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const hdrName = `${k.player_name}  \u2022  ${k.team_name}`;
    ctx.fillText(truncateText(ctx, hdrName, 1180), 68, 56);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`Live Posterior Evolution vs. ${baselineLabel}  (${modelName})`, 68, 86);

    // Right shot badge
    const totalShots = postAnimState.frames[postAnimState.frames.length - 1].s;
    const shotTag = `SHOT ${f.s} OF ${totalShots}   \u2022   ${f.d.toUpperCase()}`;
    ctx.font = "700 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const tagW = Math.min(460, ctx.measureText(shotTag).width + 36);
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, W - 68 - tagW, 28, tagW, 40, 7, theme.pillBg, theme.pillBorder, 1.5);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.fillText(shotTag, W - 68 - tagW * 0.5, 48);
    ctx.restore();

    // Plot box
    const pX = 96, pW = W - 164;
    const pTop = 148, pBot = 716;
    const pH = pBot - pTop;
    const xMin = -0.145, xMax = 0.145;
    const xToPx = (x) => pX + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * pW;
    const yToPx = (y) => pBot - (y / postAnimState.yLimit) * pH;

    postAnimState.plotMeta = { x0: pX, x1: pX + pW, y0: pTop, y1: pBot, xMin, xMax, mu: f.mu, sd: f.sd };

    ctx.save();
    // Vertical gridlines
    const ticks = [-0.12, -0.08, -0.04, 0, 0.04, 0.08, 0.12];
    ticks.forEach(t => {
      const tx = xToPx(t);
      ctx.strokeStyle = (t === 0) ? theme.needle : theme.rule;
      ctx.lineWidth = (t === 0) ? 2 : 1.2;
      if (t === 0) ctx.setLineDash([7, 5]); else ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx, pTop);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, pBot);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
    ctx.fillText("Pro Avg (0.000)", xToPx(0), pTop - 8);

    // Legend top-right
    const isPos = f.mu >= 0;
    const curveCol = isPos ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
    const legR = pX + pW;
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.priorStroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(legR - 360, pTop + 12);
    ctx.lineTo(legR - 324, pTop + 12);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.fillText("Pro Baseline Prior", legR - 314, pTop + 12);

    ctx.strokeStyle = curveCol;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(legR - 150, pTop + 12);
    ctx.lineTo(legR - 114, pTop + 12);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.fillText("Live Posterior", legR - 104, pTop + 12);

    // Draw Prior
    const steps = 280;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xMin), pBot);
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), yToPx(dnorm(xv, 0, PRIOR_SD)));
    }
    ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xMax), pBot);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.priorFill;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      const py = yToPx(dnorm(xv, 0, PRIOR_SD));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xv), py); else ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), py);
    }
    ctx.setLineDash([7, 5]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.priorStroke;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Draw Posterior
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, pTop, 0, pBot);
    grad.addColorStop(0, isPos ? "rgba(0, 116, 122, 0.34)" : "rgba(184, 58, 58, 0.32)");
    grad.addColorStop(1, isPos ? "rgba(0, 116, 122, 0.03)" : "rgba(184, 58, 58, 0.03)");

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xMin), pBot);
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), yToPx(dnorm(xv, f.mu, f.sd)));
    }
    ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xMax), pBot);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      const py = yToPx(dnorm(xv, f.mu, f.sd));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xv), py); else ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), py);
    }
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = curveCol;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Peak line & pill
    const pkX = xToPx(f.mu);
    const pkY = yToPx(f.peakY);
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = curveCol;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pkX, pkY);
    ctx.lineTo(pkX, pBot);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pkX, pkY, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = curveCol;
    ctx.fill();

    const muLbl = formatSigned(f.mu, 3);
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, pkX - 40, Math.max(pTop + 6, pkY - 38), 80, 26, 5, curveCol, null);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    ctx.font = "700 15px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(muLbl, pkX, Math.max(pTop + 19, pkY - 25));

    // Baseline + 95% CI bracket
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.ruleStrong;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pX, pBot);
    ctx.lineTo(pX + pW, pBot);
    ctx.stroke();

    const ciX0 = Math.max(pX, xToPx(f.ciLo));
    const ciX1 = Math.min(pX + pW, xToPx(f.ciHi));
    const ciY = pBot + 20;
    ctx.strokeStyle = curveCol;
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ciX0, ciY);
    ctx.lineTo(ciX1, ciY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ciX0, ciY - 7); ctx.lineTo(ciX0, ciY + 7);
    ctx.moveTo(ciX1, ciY - 7); ctx.lineTo(ciX1, ciY + 7);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(pkX, ciY, 6.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = curveCol;
    ctx.fill();

    // X ticks & title
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ticks.forEach(t => {
      const lbl = t === 0 ? "0.00 (Avg)" : (t > 0 ? "+" + t.toFixed(2) : "\u2212" + Math.abs(t).toFixed(2));
      ctx.fillText(lbl, xToPx(t), pBot + 38);
    });
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("\u2190 Below Average   \u2022   True Talent Estimate (Calibrated Goals Prevented per Shot)   \u2022   Elite Shotstopper \u2192", pX + pW * 0.5, pBot + 70);

    // Compact telemetry footer inside PNG
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, 68, 822, W - 136, 56, 8, theme.subBg, theme.cardBorder, 1.5);
    const footItems = [
      `GOALS PREVENTED: ${formatSigned(f.gp, 2)} (${f.x.toFixed(2)} xGOT)`,
      `TALENT: ${formatSigned(f.mu * 100, 2)} / 100 SHOTS`,
      `PROB ABOVE AVG: ${f.pAbove.toFixed(1)}%`,
      `SAMPLE CERTAINTY: ${Math.round(f.cert)}%`,
      `WOSO.LIVE`
    ];
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "700 16px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const segW = (W - 160) / footItems.length;
    footItems.forEach((txt, i) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = i === footItems.length - 1 ? theme.teal : theme.ink;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.fillText(txt, 80 + segW * (i + 0.5), 850);
    });
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function startPostPlayback(fromBeginning) {
    stopPostAnim();
    const n = postAnimState.frames.length;
    if (n <= 1) return;
    if (fromBeginning || postAnimState.frameIdx >= n - 1) {
      drawPosteriorFrameCanvas(0);
    }
    postAnimState.stepMs = Math.max(14, Math.min(50, Math.round(3200 / n)));
    postAnimState.lastTick = performance.now();

    const stepLoop = (now) => {
      if (now - postAnimState.lastTick >= postAnimState.stepMs) {
        const adv = Math.max(1, Math.floor((now - postAnimState.lastTick) / postAnimState.stepMs));
        const nextIdx = Math.min(n - 1, postAnimState.frameIdx + adv);
        postAnimState.lastTick = now;
        drawPosteriorFrameCanvas(nextIdx);
        if (nextIdx >= n - 1) {
          stopPostAnim();
          return;
        }
      }
      postAnimState.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(stepLoop);
    };
    postAnimState.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(stepLoop);
  }

  function renderPosteriorPlot() {
    stopPostAnim();
    const gkId = document.getElementById("gk_select").value;
    const leagueVal = document.getElementById("league_filter").value;
    const keeper = keeperById.get(gkId);
    renderTopList("post_top_list", leagueVal, gkId, (pickedId) => {
      comboRegistry["gk_select"].setSelected(pickedId);
      renderPosteriorPlot();
    });

    const st = streamMap[gkId];
    if (!st || !keeper) return;

    const sArr  = toArr(st.s).map(Number);
    const muArr = toArr(st.m).map(Number);
    const sdArr = toArr(st.sd).map(Number);
    const gpArr = toArr(st.gp).map(Number);
    const xArr  = toArr(st.x).map(Number);
    const dArr  = toArr(st.d);
    const nFrames = sArr.length;
    if (nFrames === 0) return;

    let maxY = Math.max(5.0, dnorm(0.0, 0.0, PRIOR_SD));
    const frames = new Array(nFrames);

    for (let f = 0; f < nFrames; f++) {
      const mu = muArr[f];
      const sd = sdArr[f];
      const peakY = dnorm(mu, mu, sd);
      if (peakY > maxY) maxY = peakY;
      frames[f] = {
        s: sArr[f],
        mu,
        sd,
        ciLo: mu - 1.96 * sd,
        ciHi: mu + 1.96 * sd,
        gp: gpArr[f] || 0,
        x: xArr[f] || 0,
        d: dArr[f] || "Unknown Date",
        pAbove: (1 - pnorm(0, mu, Math.max(sd, 1e-6))) * 100,
        cert: Math.max(0, Math.min(99, (1 - (sd * sd) / (PRIOR_SD * PRIOR_SD)) * 100)),
        peakY
      };
    }

    postAnimState.keeper = keeper;
    postAnimState.frames = frames;
    postAnimState.yLimit = Math.max(maxY * 1.24, 5.0);

    const scrub = document.getElementById("post_scrub_range");
    scrub.min = "0";
    scrub.max = String(nFrames - 1);

    ensureFonts().then(() => {
      drawPosteriorFrameCanvas(nFrames - 1);
    });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // TAB 3: SHAREABLE SAVE PLAYER CARD (2400 x 1500 HIGH-DPI CANVAS)
  // =========================================================================
  let saveTheme = "light";
  let saveBench = "league";
  let saveHitboxes = [];
  let savePlotMeta = null;

  function drawPlayerCardCanvas() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById("save_player_canvas");
    const gkId = document.getElementById("save_gk").value;
    const leagueVal = document.getElementById("save_league").value;
    const keeper = keeperById.get(gkId);
    if (!canvas || !keeper) return;

    renderTopList("save_top_list", leagueVal, gkId, (pickedId) => {
      comboRegistry["save_gk"].setSelected(pickedId);
      renderSaveProfile();
    });

    const bench = getBenchmarkInfo(keeper, leagueVal, saveBench);
    document.getElementById("save_cohort_caption").textContent =
      `Benchmark: ${bench.cohortLabel} (${bench.cohortSize} qualified 450+ min)`;

    const theme = THEMES[saveTheme] || THEMES.light;
    const W = 2400, H = 1500;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    saveHitboxes = [];
    savePlotMeta = null;

    // 1. Canvas Background + Club Accent Bar
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const clubBadge = resolveClubBadge(keeper.team_name);
    ctx.fillStyle = clubBadge.color || theme.teal;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 11);

    // 2. Masthead (y: 44..198)
    const redrawSafe = () => requestAnimationFrame(drawPlayerCardCanvas);
    drawClubCrest(ctx, keeper.team_name, 124, 116, 120, theme, redrawSafe);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    const nameUpper = keeper.player_name.toUpperCase();
    fitTextFont(ctx, nameUpper, 1260, 800, 62, 38);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.fillText(nameUpper, 212, 110);

    const metaParts = [keeper.team_name.toUpperCase()];
    const lgDisp = LEAGUE_SHORT_BY_ID[String(keeper.primary_league_id)] ||
      (INTL_SET.has(Number(keeper.primary_league_id)) ? "SENIOR INTL" : "");
    if (lgDisp) metaParts.push(lgDisp.toUpperCase());
    if (keeper.age !== null) metaParts.push(`AGE ${keeper.age}`);
    metaParts.push(`${Math.round(keeper.total_minutes).toLocaleString("en-US")} MINS`);
    metaParts.push(`${keeper.n_matches} ${plural(keeper.n_matches, "MATCH", "MATCHES")}`);
    const metaStr = metaParts.join("   \u2022   ");
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 24px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(truncateText(ctx, metaStr, 1260), 212, 152);
    ctx.restore();

    // Right Masthead: SAVE Mark + Cohort Rank/Pctl Badge
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "800 42px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SAVE", 2208, 92);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.teal;
    ctx.font = "700 24px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("PROFILE", 2336, 92);

    const rankStr = bench.qualified && bench.rank !== null
      ? `${getOrdinalSuffix(bench.pctl).toUpperCase()} PCTL   \u2022   #${bench.rank} OF ${bench.cohortSize} IN ${bench.cohortLabel.toUpperCase()}`
      : `UNQUALIFIED (<450 MIN)   \u2022   ${bench.cohortLabel.toUpperCase()} BENCHMARK`;
    ctx.font = "700 21px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const pillW = Math.min(760, Math.max(380, ctx.measureText(rankStr).width + 46));
    const pillX = 2336 - pillW;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, pillX, 114, pillW, 50, 8, theme.pillBg, theme.pillBorder, 2);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = bench.qualified
      ? (bench.pctl >= 50 ? theme.teal : theme.crimson)
      : theme.inkSub;
    ctx.fillText(truncateText(ctx, rankStr, pillW - 24), pillX + pillW * 0.5, 140);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.ruleStrong;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(64, 198);
    ctx.lineTo(2336, 198);
    ctx.stroke();

    // 3. Hero Split Row (y: 226..796)
    // LEFT HERO PANEL: BAYESIAN SHOT-STOPPING POSTERIOR (x: 64..1320)
    const lpX = 64, lpY = 226, lpW = 1256, lpH = 570;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, lpX, lpY, lpW, lpH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("BAYESIAN TRUE TALENT MODEL", lpX + 36, lpY + 46);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(modelName.toUpperCase(), lpX + lpW - 36, lpY + 46);
    ctx.restore();

    const isPosMu = keeper.mu >= 0;
    const muColor = isPosMu ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";

    // KPI 1: True Talent Estimate
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("TRUE TALENT ESTIMATE", lpX + 36, lpY + 90);

    ctx.fillStyle = muColor;
    ctx.font = "800 48px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const muTxt = formatSigned(keeper.mu, 3);
    ctx.fillText(muTxt, lpX + 36, lpY + 144);
    const muW = ctx.measureText(muTxt).width;
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("GP / shot", lpX + 44 + muW, lpY + 144);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "700 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${formatSigned(keeper.mu * 100, 2)} Goals / 100 Shots`, lpX + 36, lpY + 180);

    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.rule;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lpX + 420, lpY + 76);
    ctx.lineTo(lpX + 420, lpY + 186);
    ctx.stroke();

    // KPI 2: Prob Above Average
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("PROB. ABOVE AVERAGE", lpX + 452, lpY + 90);

    const pColor = keeper.p_above_avg >= 60 ? theme.teal : (keeper.p_above_avg <= 40 ? theme.crimson : theme.ink);
    ctx.fillStyle = pColor;
    ctx.font = "800 48px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const pTxt = keeper.p_above_avg >= 99.95 ? ">99.9%" : (keeper.p_above_avg <= 0.05 ? "<0.1%" : `${keeper.p_above_avg.toFixed(1)}%`);
    ctx.fillText(pTxt, lpX + 452, lpY + 144);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("P(True Talent > 0.000)", lpX + 452, lpY + 180);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lpX + 802, lpY + 76);
    ctx.lineTo(lpX + 802, lpY + 186);
    ctx.stroke();

    // KPI 3: Sample Certainty + Precision Bar + 95% CI
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SAMPLE CERTAINTY", lpX + 834, lpY + 90);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "800 48px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const certTxt = `${Math.round(keeper.certainty_pct)}%`;
    ctx.fillText(certTxt, lpX + 834, lpY + 142);
    const certW = ctx.measureText(certTxt).width;

    const shotLabelX = lpX + 848 + certW;
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${keeper.shots_faced} ${plural(keeper.shots_faced, "shot")}`, shotLabelX, lpY + 126);

    const barY = lpY + 138;
    const barW = Math.max(120, lpX + lpW - 36 - shotLabelX);
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, shotLabelX, barY, barW, 8, 4, theme.trackBg, null);
    if (keeper.certainty_pct > 0) {
      fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, shotLabelX, barY, Math.max(8, barW * (keeper.certainty_pct / 100)), 8, 4, theme.teal, null);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`95% CI: [${formatSigned(keeper.ci_low, 3)}, ${formatSigned(keeper.ci_high, 3)}]`, lpX + 834, lpY + 180);
    ctx.restore();

    // Posterior Bell Curve Plot Area (extra top headroom so Pro Avg never collides)
    const pPlotX = lpX + 48;
    const pPlotW = lpW - 96;
    const pPlotTop = lpY + 230;
    const pPlotBot = lpY + 468;
    const pPlotH = pPlotBot - pPlotTop;

    const xMin = -0.14;
    const xMax =  0.14;
    const xToPx = (x) => pPlotX + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * pPlotW;

    let peakMax = dnorm(0, 0, PRIOR_SD);
    const postPeak = dnorm(keeper.mu, keeper.mu, keeper.sd);
    if (postPeak > peakMax) peakMax = postPeak;
    const yLim = peakMax * 1.24;
    const yToPx = (y) => pPlotBot - (y / yLim) * pPlotH;

    savePlotMeta = {
      x0: pPlotX, x1: pPlotX + pPlotW, y0: pPlotTop, y1: pPlotBot,
      xMin, xMax, mu: keeper.mu, sd: keeper.sd
    };

    ctx.save();
    const xTicks = [-0.10, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10];
    xTicks.forEach(t => {
      const tx = xToPx(t);
      ctx.strokeStyle = (t === 0) ? theme.needle : theme.rule;
      ctx.lineWidth = (t === 0) ? 2 : 1.2;
      if (t === 0) ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
      else ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx, pPlotTop);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, pPlotBot);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
    ctx.fillText("Pro Avg (0.000)", xToPx(0), pPlotTop - 6);

    // Drawn visual line legend top-right of plot
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const legR = pPlotX + pPlotW;
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.priorStroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(legR - 306, pPlotTop + 10);
    ctx.lineTo(legR - 274, pPlotTop + 10);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.fillText("Pro Prior", legR - 266, pPlotTop + 10);

    ctx.strokeStyle = muColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(legR - 172, pPlotTop + 10);
    ctx.lineTo(legR - 140, pPlotTop + 10);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.fillText("Keeper Posterior", legR - 132, pPlotTop + 10);

    // Prior Curve
    const steps = 260;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xMin), pPlotBot);
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), yToPx(dnorm(xv, 0, PRIOR_SD)));
    }
    ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xMax), pPlotBot);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.priorFill;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      const py = yToPx(dnorm(xv, 0, PRIOR_SD));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xv), py); else ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), py);
    }
    ctx.setLineDash([7, 5]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.priorStroke;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Keeper Posterior Curve
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, pPlotTop, 0, pPlotBot);
    grad.addColorStop(0, isPosMu ? (saveTheme === "dark" ? "rgba(32,178,170,0.44)" : "rgba(0,116,122,0.34)") : (saveTheme === "dark" ? "rgba(226,106,90,0.44)" : "rgba(184,58,58,0.34)"));
    grad.addColorStop(1, isPosMu ? "rgba(0,116,122,0.03)" : "rgba(184,58,58,0.03)");

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xMin), pPlotBot);
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), yToPx(dnorm(xv, keeper.mu, keeper.sd)));
    }
    ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xMax), pPlotBot);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      const py = yToPx(dnorm(xv, keeper.mu, keeper.sd));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xv), py); else ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), py);
    }
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = muColor;
    ctx.stroke();

    const peakX = xToPx(keeper.mu);
    const peakY = yToPx(postPeak);
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = muColor;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(peakX, peakY);
    ctx.lineTo(peakX, pPlotBot);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(peakX, peakY, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = muColor;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.ruleStrong;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pPlotX, pPlotBot);
    ctx.lineTo(pPlotX + pPlotW, pPlotBot);
    ctx.stroke();

    const ciX0 = Math.max(pPlotX, xToPx(keeper.ci_low));
    const ciX1 = Math.min(pPlotX + pPlotW, xToPx(keeper.ci_high));
    const ciY = pPlotBot + 18;
    ctx.strokeStyle = muColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ciX0, ciY);
    ctx.lineTo(ciX1, ciY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ciX0, ciY - 7); ctx.lineTo(ciX0, ciY + 7);
    ctx.moveTo(ciX1, ciY - 7); ctx.lineTo(ciX1, ciY + 7);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(peakX, ciY, 6.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = muColor;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    xTicks.forEach(t => {
      const lbl = t === 0 ? "0.00" : (t > 0 ? "+" + t.toFixed(2) : "\u2212" + Math.abs(t).toFixed(2));
      ctx.fillText(lbl, xToPx(t), pPlotBot + 36);
    });

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("\u2190 Below Average    \u2022    95% Credible Interval Bracket    \u2022    Elite Shotstopper \u2192", pPlotX + pPlotW * 0.5, pPlotBot + 66);
    ctx.restore();

    // RIGHT HERO PANEL: SEASON LEDGER & SHOT DIET (x: 1356..2336)
    const rpX = 1356, rpY = 226, rpW = 980, rpH = 570;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, rpX, rpY, rpW, rpH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SEASON SHOT-STOPPING LEDGER", rpX + 36, rpY + 46);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`BENCHMARK: ${bench.cohortLabel.toUpperCase()} AVG`, rpX + rpW - 36, rpY + 46);

    const midX = rpX + rpW * 0.5;
    const midY = rpY + 228;
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.rule;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(rpX + 36, midY);
    ctx.lineTo(rpX + rpW - 36, midY);
    ctx.moveTo(midX, rpY + 74);
    ctx.lineTo(midX, rpY + 378);
    ctx.moveTo(rpX + 36, rpY + 390);
    ctx.lineTo(rpX + rpW - 36, rpY + 390);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.textAlign = "left";

    // Cell 1: Goals Prevented
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("GOALS PREVENTED (GP)", rpX + 36, rpY + 104);
    ctx.fillStyle = keeper.total_gp >= 0 ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
    ctx.font = "800 50px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(formatSigned(keeper.total_gp, 2), rpX + 36, rpY + 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${keeper.total_xgot.toFixed(2)} xGOT Faced  \u2022  ${keeper.goals_allowed} GA`, rpX + 36, rpY + 196);

    // Cell 2: GP / 10 xGOT
    const c2X = midX + 34;
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("GP / 10 xGOT FACED", c2X, rpY + 104);
    ctx.fillStyle = keeper.gp_10xgot >= bench.lgGp10 ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
    ctx.font = "800 50px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(formatSigned(keeper.gp_10xgot, 2), c2X, rpY + 160);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const gp10BenchStr = bench.qualified
      ? `${bench.cohortLabel} Avg: ${formatSigned(bench.lgGp10, 2)}  \u2022  ${getOrdinalSuffix(bench.gp10Pctl)} Pctl`
      : `${bench.cohortLabel} Avg: ${formatSigned(bench.lgGp10, 2)}`;
    ctx.fillText(gp10BenchStr, c2X, rpY + 196);

    // Cell 3: Save % vs xSv%
    const svDiff = keeper.sv_pct - keeper.x_sv_pct;
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SAVE % vs EXPECTED (xSv%)", rpX + 36, rpY + 266);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "800 50px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const svTxt = `${keeper.sv_pct.toFixed(1)}%`;
    ctx.fillText(svTxt, rpX + 36, rpY + 322);
    const svW = ctx.measureText(svTxt).width;
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 21px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`vs ${keeper.x_sv_pct.toFixed(1)}% exp.`, rpX + 48 + svW, rpY + 322);
    ctx.fillStyle = svDiff >= 0 ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
    ctx.font = "700 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${formatSigned(svDiff, 1)} pts vs Expected Save Rate`, rpX + 36, rpY + 356);

    // Cell 4: AxA% Consistency
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("MATCH CONSISTENCY (AxA%)", c2X, rpY + 266);
    ctx.fillStyle = keeper.axa_pct >= bench.lgAxa ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
    ctx.font = "800 50px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${keeper.axa_pct.toFixed(1)}%`, c2X, rpY + 322);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${keeper.pos_matches} of ${keeper.n_matches} ${plural(keeper.n_matches, "Match", "Matches")} > 0 GP  \u2022  Avg: ${bench.lgAxa.toFixed(1)}%`, c2X, rpY + 356);

    // Bottom Strip: Workload & Shot Diet Mix
    const minsSafe = keeper.total_minutes > 0 ? keeper.total_minutes : null;
    const p90 = minsSafe ? 90 / minsSafe : 0;
    const sh90 = keeper.total_shots * p90;
    const x90  = keeper.total_xgot * p90;
    const qDiff = keeper.avg_shot_xgot - globalAvgXgot;

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("WORKLOAD & SHOT DIET", rpX + 36, rpY + 428);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "700 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const wlText = minsSafe
      ? `${sh90.toFixed(2)} Shots/90   \u2022   ${x90.toFixed(2)} xGOT/90   \u2022   ${keeper.avg_shot_xgot.toFixed(3)} xGOT/Shot (${formatSigned(qDiff, 3)} vs Avg)`
      : `${keeper.total_shots} Shots Faced   \u2022   ${keeper.avg_shot_xgot.toFixed(3)} xGOT/Shot`;
    ctx.fillText(wlText, rpX + rpW - 36, rpY + 428);

    const sdBarX = rpX + 36;
    const sdBarY = rpY + 450;
    const sdBarW = rpW - 72;
    const sdBarH = 42;
    const totCQ = Math.max(1, keeper.total_shots);
    const pHigh = keeper.cq_high.sf / totCQ;
    const pMed  = keeper.cq_med.sf / totCQ;
    const pLow  = keeper.cq_low.sf / totCQ;

    ctx.save();
    roundRectPath(ctx, sdBarX, sdBarY, sdBarW, sdBarH, 7);
    ctx.clip();
    const wH = sdBarW * pHigh;
    const wM = sdBarW * pMed;
    const wL = sdBarW - wH - wM;
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.dietHigh;
    ctx.fillRect(sdBarX, sdBarY, wH, sdBarH);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.dietMed;
    ctx.fillRect(sdBarX + wH, sdBarY, wM, sdBarH);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.dietLow;
    ctx.fillRect(sdBarX + wH + wM, sdBarY, wL, sdBarH);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.cardBg;
    if (wH > 1 && wM > 1) ctx.fillRect(sdBarX + wH - 1, sdBarY, 2.5, sdBarH);
    if ((wH + wM) > 1 && wL > 1) ctx.fillRect(sdBarX + wH + wM - 1, sdBarY, 2.5, sdBarH);

    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "700 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    if (wH >= 78) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
      ctx.fillText(`HD ${Math.round(pHigh * 100)}%`, sdBarX + wH * 0.5, sdBarY + sdBarH * 0.5);
    }
    if (wM >= 78) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#111827";
      ctx.fillText(`MD ${Math.round(pMed * 100)}%`, sdBarX + wH + wM * 0.5, sdBarY + sdBarH * 0.5);
    }
    if (wL >= 78) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
      ctx.fillText(`LD ${Math.round(pLow * 100)}%`, sdBarX + wH + wM + wL * 0.5, sdBarY + sdBarH * 0.5);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    saveHitboxes.push(
      { x: sdBarX, y: sdBarY, w: wH, h: sdBarH, text: `<b>High Danger (>0.35 xGOT)</b><br>${keeper.cq_high.sf} shots (${(pHigh * 100).toFixed(1)}%)` },
      { x: sdBarX + wH, y: sdBarY, w: wM, h: sdBarH, text: `<b>Medium Danger (0.11\u20130.35 xGOT)</b><br>${keeper.cq_med.sf} shots (${(pMed * 100).toFixed(1)}%)` },
      { x: sdBarX + wH + wM, y: sdBarY, w: wL, h: sdBarH, text: `<b>Low Danger (\u22640.10 xGOT)</b><br>${keeper.cq_low.sf} shots (${(pLow * 100).toFixed(1)}%)` }
    );

    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    const legY = rpY + 524;
    const segLegends = [
      { col: theme.dietHigh, lbl: `High (>0.35): ${keeper.cq_high.sf} sh (${Math.round(pHigh * 100)}%)` },
      { col: theme.dietMed,  lbl: `Med (0.11\u20130.35): ${keeper.cq_med.sf} sh (${Math.round(pMed * 100)}%)` },
      { col: theme.dietLow,  lbl: `Low (\u22640.10): ${keeper.cq_low.sf} sh (${Math.round(pLow * 100)}%)` }
    ];
    let lx = sdBarX;
    segLegends.forEach((sl) => {
      fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, lx, legY - 8, 16, 16, 3, sl.col, null);
      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
      ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(sl.lbl, lx + 24, legY);
      lx += 302;
    });
    ctx.restore();

    // 4. Bottom Split Row (y: 824..1422)
    // BOTTOM-LEFT: SAVE EFFICIENCY BY CHANCE QUALITY (x: 64..1182)
    const blX = 64, blY = 824, blW = 1118, blH = 598;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, blX, blY, blW, blH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("SAVE EFFICIENCY BY CHANCE QUALITY", blX + 36, blY + 46);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`VERTICAL NEEDLE = ${bench.cohortLabel.toUpperCase()} AVG`, blX + blW - 36, blY + 46);

    const tiers = [
      { key: "High", title: "High Danger (HDSv%)", sub: "> 0.35 xGOT  \u2022  1v1s & Top-Corner Strikes", split: keeper.cq_high },
      { key: "Medium", title: "Medium Danger (MDSv%)", sub: "0.11 \u2013 0.35 xGOT  \u2022  In-Box Contested Shots", split: keeper.cq_med },
      { key: "Low", title: "Low Danger (LDSv%)", sub: "\u2264 0.10 xGOT  \u2022  Long-Range & Routine Saves", split: keeper.cq_low }
    ];

    const barTrackX = blX + 36;
    const barTrackW = blW - 72;
    const barTrackH = 38;

    tiers.forEach((tier, idx) => {
      const ty = blY + 108 + idx * 158;
      const sf = tier.split.sf;
      const ga = tier.split.ga;
      const svPct = sf > 0 ? ((sf - ga) / sf) * 100 : null;
      const lgAvg = bench.lgCqAvg[tier.key] ?? 50;
      const glAvg = bench.glCqAvg[tier.key] ?? lgAvg;

      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
      ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
      ctx.font = "700 24px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(tier.title, barTrackX, ty);

      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
      ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(tier.sub, barTrackX, ty + 25);

      ctx.textAlign = "right";
      if (svPct !== null) {
        const diff = svPct - lgAvg;
        const barCol = diff >= 0 ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
        const diffStr = `${formatSigned(diff, 1)} pts vs ${bench.cohortLabel}`;

        ctx.fillStyle = barCol;
        ctx.font = "700 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
        ctx.fillText(diffStr, barTrackX + barTrackW, ty + 24);

        const saves = sf - ga;
        const countTxt = `(${saves}/${sf})`;
        ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
        ctx.font = "600 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
        const countW = ctx.measureText(countTxt).width;
        ctx.fillText(countTxt, barTrackX + barTrackW, ty);

        ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
        ctx.font = "800 32px Assistant, sans-serif";
        ctx.fillText(`${svPct.toFixed(1)}%`, barTrackX + barTrackW - countW - 12, ty);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
        ctx.font = "700 24px Assistant, sans-serif";
        ctx.fillText("\u2014 (0 shots faced)", barTrackX + barTrackW, ty + 6);
      }

      const by = ty + 42;
      fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, barTrackX, by, barTrackW, barTrackH, 7, theme.trackBg, null);

      if (svPct !== null && svPct > 0) {
        const fw = Math.max(12, barTrackW * Math.min(1, svPct / 100));
        const barCol = (svPct >= lgAvg) ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;
        fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, barTrackX, by, fw, barTrackH, 7, barCol, null);
      }

      const nx = barTrackX + barTrackW * (Math.max(0, Math.min(100, lgAvg)) / 100);
      ctx.strokeStyle = theme.needle;
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(nx, by - 7);
      ctx.lineTo(nx, by + barTrackH + 7);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
      ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = nx > barTrackX + barTrackW - 110 ? "right" : (nx < barTrackX + 90 ? "left" : "center");
      ctx.textBaseline = "top";
      ctx.fillText(`Avg: ${lgAvg.toFixed(1)}%`, nx, by + barTrackH + 11);

      saveHitboxes.push({
        x: barTrackX, y: by - 10, w: barTrackW, h: barTrackH + 24,
        text: svPct !== null
          ? `<b>${tier.title}</b><br>Saved: ${sf - ga} / ${sf} (${svPct.toFixed(1)}%)<br>${bench.cohortLabel} Avg: ${lgAvg.toFixed(1)}%  |  Global Avg: ${glAvg.toFixed(1)}%`
          : `<b>${tier.title}</b><br>0 shots faced in this danger tier`
      });
    });

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "600 16px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    [0, 25, 50, 75, 100].forEach(pct => {
      const px = barTrackX + barTrackW * (pct / 100);
      ctx.textAlign = pct === 0 ? "left" : (pct === 100 ? "right" : "center");
      ctx.fillText(`${pct}%`, px, blY + blH - 18);
    });
    ctx.restore();

    // BOTTOM-RIGHT: GAME-BY-GAME GOALS PREVENTED FORM (x: 1218..2336)
    const brX = 1218, brY = 824, brW = 1118, brH = 598;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, brX, brY, brW, brH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("GAME-BY-GAME GOALS PREVENTED", brX + 36, brY + 46);

    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const matchStr = `${keeper.n_matches} ${plural(keeper.n_matches, "MATCH", "MATCHES")}`;
    const csStr    = `${keeper.clean_sheets} ${plural(keeper.clean_sheets, "CLEAN SHEET", "CLEAN SHEETS")}`;
    ctx.fillText(`${matchStr}  \u2022  ${csStr}`, brX + brW - 36, brY + 46);

    const mRows = keeper.matches || [];
    let bestM = null, worstM = null, maxAbsM = 1.5;
    mRows.forEach(m => {
      if (!bestM || m.gp > bestM.gp) bestM = m;
      if (!worstM || m.gp < worstM.gp) worstM = m;
      if (Math.abs(m.gp) > maxAbsM) maxAbsM = Math.abs(m.gp);
    });
    const yBound = Math.ceil(maxAbsM * 1.15 * 2) / 2;

    const validDates = mRows.filter(m => m.d).map(m => m.df);
    const spanStr = validDates.length >= 2
      ? `${validDates[0]} \u2013 ${validDates[validDates.length - 1]}`
      : (validDates.length === 1 ? validDates[0] : "Date Range Unavailable");

    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 19px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(spanStr, brX + 36, brY + 84);

    if (bestM && worstM) {
      ctx.textAlign = "right";
      ctx.fillText(`Peak: ${formatSigned(bestM.gp, 2)} GP   \u2022   Low: ${formatSigned(worstM.gp, 2)} GP`, brX + brW - 36, brY + 84);
    }

    const fPlotX = brX + 86;
    const fPlotW = brW - 122;
    const fPlotTop = brY + 122;
    const fPlotBot = brY + 510;
    const fMidY = (fPlotTop + fPlotBot) * 0.5;
    const fHalfH = (fPlotBot - fPlotTop) * 0.5;

    const gLevels = [yBound, yBound * 0.5, 0, -yBound * 0.5, -yBound];
    gLevels.forEach(lvl => {
      const gy = fMidY - (lvl / yBound) * fHalfH;
      ctx.strokeStyle = (lvl === 0) ? theme.needle : theme.rule;
      ctx.lineWidth = (lvl === 0) ? 2.5 : 1.2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(fPlotX, gy);
      ctx.lineTo(fPlotX + fPlotW, gy);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
      ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "right";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      const lbl = lvl === 0 ? "0.0" : formatSigned(lvl, 1);
      ctx.fillText(lbl, fPlotX - 12, gy);
    });

    if (mRows.length > 0) {
      const slotW = fPlotW / mRows.length;
      const gap = slotW > 14 ? Math.min(6, slotW * 0.22) : (slotW > 6 ? 1.5 : 0.8);
      const bw = Math.max(2, Math.min(34, slotW - gap));
      const startOff = mRows.length * slotW < fPlotW ? (fPlotW - mRows.length * slotW) * 0.5 : 0;

      mRows.forEach((m, idx) => {
        const cx = fPlotX + startOff + (idx + 0.5) * slotW;
        const bx = cx - bw * 0.5;
        const bh = Math.max(2, (Math.abs(m.gp) / yBound) * fHalfH);
        const isPos = m.gp > 0;
        const by = isPos ? (fMidY - bh) : fMidY;
        const col = isPos ? theme.teal : theme.crimson;

        ctx.fillStyle = col;
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);

        saveHitboxes.push({
          x: bx - gap * 0.5, y: fPlotTop, w: bw + gap, h: fPlotBot - fPlotTop,
