```{=html}
          text: `<b>Match ${idx + 1} (${m.df})</b><br>Goals Prevented: ${formatSigned(m.gp, 2)}<br>xGOT Faced: ${m.x.toFixed(2)}  |  Goals Allowed: ${m.g}`
        });
      });
    }

    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.needle;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fPlotX, fMidY);
    ctx.lineTo(fPlotX + fPlotW, fMidY);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Chronological Match Appearances (Oldest \u2192 Most Recent)", fPlotX + fPlotW * 0.5, brY + brH - 42);

    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, fPlotX, brY + brH - 25, 14, 14, 3, theme.teal, null);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 16px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Outperformed xGOT (GP > 0)", fPlotX + 20, brY + brH - 13);

    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, fPlotX + 270, brY + brH - 25, 14, 14, 3, theme.crimson, null);
    ctx.fillText("Allowed Above xGOT (GP \u2264 0)", fPlotX + 290, brY + brH - 13);
    ctx.restore();

    // 5. Card Footer
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("WOSO.LIVE   \u2022   GLOBAL GOALKEEPER EVALUATION", 64, 1468);

    const lastDateStr = validDates.length > 0 ? `Latest Match: ${validDates[validDates.length - 1]}` : "Non-Penalty xGOT Shots";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${modelName}  \u2022  Non-Penalty xGOT  \u2022  ${lastDateStr}`, 2336, 1468);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function renderSaveMatchTable(keeper) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById("save_match_tbody");
    const titleEl = document.getElementById("save_log_title");
    if (!tbody || !keeper) return;
    titleEl.textContent = `${keeper.player_name} \u2014 Match-by-Match Shot-Stopping Log (${keeper.n_matches} ${plural(keeper.n_matches, "match", "matches")})`;
    const rows = (keeper.matches || []).slice().reverse();
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center;color:#64748B;padding:1rem;">No match log records available.</td></tr>`;
      return;
    }
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map((m, i) => {
      const seqNum = rows.length - i;
      const cls = m.gp > 0 ? "gk-val-pos" : "gk-val-neg";
      const cumCls = m.cumGp >= 0 ? "gk-val-pos" : "gk-val-neg";
      return `<tr>
        <td>${seqNum}</td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(m.df)}</td>
        <td class="num">${m.x.toFixed(2)}</td>
        <td class="num">${m.g}</td>
        <td class="num"><span class="${cls}">${formatSigned(m.gp, 2)}</span></td>
        <td class="num"><span class="${cumCls}">${formatSigned(m.cumGp, 2)}</span></td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderSaveProfile() {
    const gkId = document.getElementById("save_gk").value;
    const keeper = keeperById.get(gkId);
    if (!keeper) return;
    renderSaveMatchTable(keeper);
    ensureFonts().then(() => {
      drawPlayerCardCanvas();
    });
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // TAB 2: HEAD-TO-HEAD DUEL CARD (2400 x 1450 HIGH-DPI CANVAS)
  // =========================================================================
  let compTheme = "light";
  let compPlotMeta = null;

  function drawDuelCardCanvas() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById("comp_duel_canvas");
    const gkAId = document.getElementById("comp_gk_a").value;
    const gkBId = document.getElementById("comp_gk_b").value;
    const kA = keeperById.get(gkAId);
    const kB = keeperById.get(gkBId);
    if (!canvas || !kA || !kB) return;

    const theme = THEMES[compTheme] || THEMES.light;
    const colA = theme.teal;
    const colB = compTheme === "dark" ? "#EB8258" : "#C8553D";
    const fillA = compTheme === "dark" ? "rgba(32, 178, 170, 0.28)" : "rgba(0, 116, 122, 0.25)";
    const fillB = compTheme === "dark" ? "rgba(235, 130, 88, 0.28)" : "rgba(200, 85, 61, 0.24)";

    const W = 2400, H = 1450;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    compPlotMeta = null;

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.fillStyle = colA;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W * 0.5, 11);
    ctx.fillStyle = colB;
    ctx.fillRect(W * 0.5, 0, W * 0.5, 11);

    const redrawSafe = () => requestAnimationFrame(drawDuelCardCanvas);
    const lgA = document.getElementById("comp_league_a").value;
    const lgB = document.getElementById("comp_league_b").value;
    const benchA = getBenchmarkInfo(kA, lgA, "league");
    const benchB = getBenchmarkInfo(kB, lgB, "league");

    drawClubCrest(ctx, kA.team_name, 124, 118, 116, theme, redrawSafe);
    drawClubCrest(ctx, kB.team_name, 2276, 118, 116, theme, redrawSafe);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    fitTextFont(ctx, kA.player_name.toUpperCase(), 820, 800, 50, 32);
    ctx.fillStyle = colA;
    ctx.fillText(kA.player_name.toUpperCase(), 208, 108);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 22px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const rankATxt = benchA.qualified && benchA.rank ? `#${benchA.rank} in ${benchA.cohortLabel} (${getOrdinalSuffix(benchA.pctl)})` : benchA.cohortLabel;
    ctx.fillText(truncateText(ctx, `${kA.team_name.toUpperCase()}  \u2022  ${rankATxt}  \u2022  ${kA.shots_faced} SHOTS`, 840), 208, 148);

    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, 1152, 84, 96, 56, 28, theme.pillBg, theme.pillBorder, 2);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "800 24px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("VS", 1200, 112);

    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    fitTextFont(ctx, kB.player_name.toUpperCase(), 820, 800, 50, 32);
    ctx.fillStyle = colB;
    ctx.fillText(kB.player_name.toUpperCase(), 2192, 108);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 22px Assistant, sans-serif";
    const rankBTxt = benchB.qualified && benchB.rank ? `#${benchB.rank} in ${benchB.cohortLabel} (${getOrdinalSuffix(benchB.pctl)})` : benchB.cohortLabel;
    ctx.fillText(truncateText(ctx, `${kB.shots_faced} SHOTS  \u2022  ${rankBTxt}  \u2022  ${kB.team_name.toUpperCase()}`, 840), 2192, 148);
    ctx.restore();

    // Superiority Banner
    const diffSd = Math.sqrt(kA.sd * kA.sd + kB.sd * kB.sd);
    const probA = (1 - pnorm(0, kA.mu - kB.mu, Math.max(diffSd, 1e-6))) * 100;
    const probB = 100 - probA;

    const banX = 64, banY = 196, banW = 2272, banH = 148;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, banX, banY, banW, banH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    const verdictName = probA >= 50 ? kA.player_name : kB.player_name;
    const verdictProb = Math.max(probA, probB);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("BAYESIAN PROBABILITY OF SUPERIORITY  \u2022  P(TRUE TALENT A > TRUE TALENT B)", 1200, banY + 36);

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "800 32px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${verdictName.toUpperCase()} IS ${verdictProb.toFixed(1)}% LIKELY TO BE THE SUPERIOR SHOTSTOPPER`, 1200, banY + 76);

    const sBarX = banX + 48, sBarY = banY + 94, sBarW = banW - 96, sBarH = 32;
    const wA = sBarW * (probA / 100);
    ctx.save();
    roundRectPath(ctx, sBarX, sBarY, sBarW, sBarH, 7);
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = colA;
    ctx.fillRect(sBarX, sBarY, wA, sBarH);
    ctx.fillStyle = colB;
    ctx.fillRect(sBarX + wA, sBarY, sBarW - wA, sBarH);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.cardBg;
    ctx.fillRect(sBarX + wA - 1.5, sBarY, 3, sBarH);
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.font = "800 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
    if (wA > 140) {
      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.fillText(`${probA.toFixed(1)}%`, sBarX + 16, sBarY + sBarH * 0.5);
    }
    if ((sBarW - wA) > 140) {
      ctx.textAlign = "right";
      ctx.fillText(`${probB.toFixed(1)}%`, sBarX + sBarW - 16, sBarY + sBarH * 0.5);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // Lower Split: Posterior Distributions (Left) + Tale of the Tape (Right)
    const lpX = 64, lpY = 368, lpW = 1230, lpH = 1004;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, lpX, lpY, lpW, lpH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("POSTERIOR TALENT DISTRIBUTIONS", lpX + 36, lpY + 46);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("OVERLAPPING 95% CREDIBLE INTERVALS", lpX + lpW - 36, lpY + 46);

    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, lpX + 36, lpY + 72, 18, 18, 4, colA, null);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.ink;
    ctx.font = "700 21px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${kA.player_name} (${formatSigned(kA.mu, 3)} \u00B1 ${(1.96 * kA.sd).toFixed(3)})`, lpX + 64, lpY + 88);

    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, lpX + 36, lpY + 106, 18, 18, 4, colB, null);
    ctx.fillText(`${kB.player_name} (${formatSigned(kB.mu, 3)} \u00B1 ${(1.96 * kB.sd).toFixed(3)})`, lpX + 64, lpY + 122);

    // Dashed Prior legend on right of legend band
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.priorStroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lpX + lpW - 230, lpY + 82);
    ctx.lineTo(lpX + lpW - 196, lpY + 82);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Pro Baseline Prior", lpX + lpW - 188, lpY + 88);

    const pX0 = lpX + 48, pW = lpW - 96;
    const pTop = lpY + 188, pBot = lpY + 768;
    const pH = pBot - pTop;
    const xMin = -0.14, xMax = 0.14;
    const xToPx = (x) => pX0 + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * pW;

    const peakA = dnorm(kA.mu, kA.mu, kA.sd);
    const peakB = dnorm(kB.mu, kB.mu, kB.sd);
    const yLim = Math.max(peakA, peakB, dnorm(0, 0, PRIOR_SD)) * 1.20;
    const yToPx = (y) => pBot - (y / yLim) * pH;

    compPlotMeta = { x0: pX0, x1: pX0 + pW, y0: pTop, y1: pBot, xMin, xMax, kA, kB };

    const ticks = [-0.10, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10];
    ticks.forEach(t => {
      const tx = xToPx(t);
      ctx.strokeStyle = (t === 0) ? theme.needle : theme.rule;
      ctx.lineWidth = (t === 0) ? 2 : 1.2;
      if (t === 0) ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]); else ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tx, pTop);
      ctx.lineTo(tx, pBot);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillText("Pro Avg (0.000)", xToPx(0), pTop - 10);

    const steps = 260;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
      const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
      const py = yToPx(dnorm(xv, 0, PRIOR_SD));
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xv), py); else ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), py);
    }
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.priorStroke;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    [
      { k: kA, col: colA, fill: fillA, pk: peakA },
      { k: kB, col: colB, fill: fillB, pk: peakB }
    ].forEach(({ k, col, fill, pk }) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xMin), pBot);
      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
        ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), yToPx(dnorm(xv, k.mu, k.sd)));
      }
      ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xMax), pBot);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const xv = xMin + ((xMax - xMin) * i) / steps;
        const py = yToPx(dnorm(xv, k.mu, k.sd));
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(xToPx(xv), py); else ctx.lineTo(xToPx(xv), py);
      }
      ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.strokeStyle = col;
      ctx.stroke();

      const mx = xToPx(k.mu);
      const my = yToPx(pk);
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
      ctx.strokeStyle = col;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(mx, my);
      ctx.lineTo(mx, pBot);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    });

    ctx.strokeStyle = theme.ruleStrong;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(pX0, pBot);
    ctx.lineTo(pX0 + pW, pBot);
    ctx.stroke();

    [
      { k: kA, col: colA, yOff: 26 },
      { k: kB, col: colB, yOff: 62 }
    ].forEach(({ k, col, yOff }) => {
      const cy = pBot + yOff;
      const x0 = Math.max(pX0, xToPx(k.ci_low));
      const x1 = Math.min(pX0 + pW, xToPx(k.ci_high));
      const xm = xToPx(k.mu);
      ctx.strokeStyle = col;
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x0, cy);
      ctx.lineTo(x1, cy);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(xm, cy, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = col;
      ctx.fill();
    });

    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ticks.forEach(t => {
      const lbl = t === 0 ? "0.00" : (t > 0 ? "+" + t.toFixed(2) : "\u2212" + Math.abs(t).toFixed(2));
      ctx.fillText(lbl, xToPx(t), pBot + 96);
    });
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("True Talent Estimate (Calibrated Goals Prevented per Shot)  \u2022  95% Credible Intervals Shown", pX0 + pW * 0.5, pBot + 132);
    ctx.restore();

    // RIGHT PANEL: TALE OF THE TAPE
    const rpX = 1324, rpY = 368, rpW = 1012, rpH = 1004;
    fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, rpX, rpY, rpW, rpH, 12, theme.cardBg, theme.cardBorder, 2);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "800 20px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("HEAD-TO-HEAD TALE OF THE TAPE", rpX + 36, rpY + 46);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("BOLD INDICATES LEADER", rpX + rpW - 36, rpY + 46);

    const metrics = [
      {
        label: "TRUE TALENT (GP / 100 SHOTS)",
        vA: kA.mu * 100, vB: kB.mu * 100,
        fA: formatSigned(kA.mu * 100, 2), fB: formatSigned(kB.mu * 100, 2),
        subA: `${formatSigned(kA.mu, 3)}/sh  \u2022  ${Math.round(kA.certainty_pct)}% cert.`,
        subB: `${formatSigned(kB.mu, 3)}/sh  \u2022  ${Math.round(kB.certainty_pct)}% cert.`,
        maxRef: Math.max(7.0, Math.abs(kA.mu * 100), Math.abs(kB.mu * 100)), zeroShift: false
      },
      {
        label: "GOALS PREVENTED (TOTAL)",
        vA: kA.total_gp, vB: kB.total_gp,
        fA: formatSigned(kA.total_gp, 2), fB: formatSigned(kB.total_gp, 2),
        subA: `${kA.total_xgot.toFixed(1)} xGOT  \u2022  ${kA.goals_allowed} GA`,
        subB: `${kB.total_xgot.toFixed(1)} xGOT  \u2022  ${kB.goals_allowed} GA`,
        maxRef: Math.max(10, Math.abs(kA.total_gp), Math.abs(kB.total_gp)), zeroShift: false
      },
      {
        label: "GP / 10 xGOT FACED",
        vA: kA.gp_10xgot, vB: kB.gp_10xgot,
        fA: formatSigned(kA.gp_10xgot, 2), fB: formatSigned(kB.gp_10xgot, 2),
        subA: `${kA.n_matches} ${plural(kA.n_matches, "match", "matches")}`,
        subB: `${kB.n_matches} ${plural(kB.n_matches, "match", "matches")}`,
        maxRef: Math.max(5.0, Math.abs(kA.gp_10xgot), Math.abs(kB.gp_10xgot)), zeroShift: false
      },
      {
        label: "SAVE % ABOVE EXPECTED (Sv% \u2212 xSv%)",
        vA: kA.sv_pct - kA.x_sv_pct, vB: kB.sv_pct - kB.x_sv_pct,
        fA: formatSigned(kA.sv_pct - kA.x_sv_pct, 1) + "%", fB: formatSigned(kB.sv_pct - kB.x_sv_pct, 1) + "%",
        subA: `${kA.sv_pct.toFixed(1)}% vs ${kA.x_sv_pct.toFixed(1)}%`,
        subB: `${kB.sv_pct.toFixed(1)}% vs ${kB.x_sv_pct.toFixed(1)}%`,
        maxRef: Math.max(12.0, Math.abs(kA.sv_pct - kA.x_sv_pct), Math.abs(kB.sv_pct - kB.x_sv_pct)), zeroShift: false
      },
      {
        label: "HIGH-DANGER SAVE % (HDSv%)",
        vA: kA.cq_high.sf > 0 ? ((kA.cq_high.sf - kA.cq_high.ga) / kA.cq_high.sf) * 100 : null,
        vB: kB.cq_high.sf > 0 ? ((kB.cq_high.sf - kB.cq_high.ga) / kB.cq_high.sf) * 100 : null,
        fA: kA.cq_high.sf > 0 ? (((kA.cq_high.sf - kA.cq_high.ga) / kA.cq_high.sf) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "\u2014",
        fB: kB.cq_high.sf > 0 ? (((kB.cq_high.sf - kB.cq_high.ga) / kB.cq_high.sf) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%" : "\u2014",
        subA: `${kA.cq_high.sf - kA.cq_high.ga}/${kA.cq_high.sf} HD saved`,
        subB: `${kB.cq_high.sf - kB.cq_high.ga}/${kB.cq_high.sf} HD saved`,
        maxRef: 100, zeroShift: true
      },
      {
        label: "MATCH CONSISTENCY (AxA%)",
        vA: kA.axa_pct, vB: kB.axa_pct,
        fA: `${kA.axa_pct.toFixed(1)}%`, fB: `${kB.axa_pct.toFixed(1)}%`,
        subA: `${kA.pos_matches}/${kA.n_matches} > 0 GP`,
        subB: `${kB.pos_matches}/${kB.n_matches} > 0 GP`,
        maxRef: 100, zeroShift: true
      }
    ];

    const cX = rpX + rpW * 0.5;
    const halfBarW = 420;
    metrics.forEach((m, idx) => {
      const ry = rpY + 112 + idx * 145;
      if (idx > 0) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = theme.rule;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(rpX + 36, ry - 32);
        ctx.lineTo(rpX + rpW - 36, ry - 32);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const bothNum = m.vA !== null && m.vB !== null;
      const aLeads = bothNum && m.vA > m.vB;
      const bLeads = bothNum && m.vB > m.vA;

      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
      ctx.font = "800 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(m.label, cX, ry);

      ctx.textAlign = "left";
      ctx.fillStyle = aLeads ? colA : theme.ink;
      ctx.font = `${aLeads ? 800 : 600} 34px Assistant, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillText(m.fA, rpX + 36, ry + 36);
      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
      ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(m.subA, rpX + 36, ry + 60);

      ctx.textAlign = "right";
      ctx.fillStyle = bLeads ? colB : theme.ink;
      ctx.font = `${bLeads ? 800 : 600} 34px Assistant, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillText(m.fB, rpX + rpW - 36, ry + 36);
      ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkSub;
      ctx.font = "600 17px Assistant, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(m.subB, rpX + rpW - 36, ry + 60);

      const barY = ry + 74;
      const barH = 16;
      const leftTrackX = cX - halfBarW - 8;
      const rightTrackX = cX + 8;

      fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, leftTrackX, barY, halfBarW, barH, 4, theme.trackBg, null);
      fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, rightTrackX, barY, halfBarW, barH, 4, theme.trackBg, null);

      const magA = m.vA === null ? 0 : (m.zeroShift ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.vA / m.maxRef)) : Math.max(0.05, Math.min(1, (m.vA + m.maxRef) / (2 * m.maxRef))));
      const magB = m.vB === null ? 0 : (m.zeroShift ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, m.vB / m.maxRef)) : Math.max(0.05, Math.min(1, (m.vB + m.maxRef) / (2 * m.maxRef))));

      if (m.vA !== null) {
        const wLeft = halfBarW * magA;
        fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, cX - 8 - wLeft, barY, wLeft, barH, 4, colA, null);
      }
      if (m.vB !== null) {
        const wRight = halfBarW * magB;
        fillStrokeRoundRect(ctx, rightTrackX, barY, wRight, barH, 4, colB, null);
      }
    });
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic";
    ctx.fillStyle = theme.inkMuted;
    ctx.font = "700 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.fillText("WOSO.LIVE   \u2022   BAYESIAN HEAD-TO-HEAD COMPARISON", 64, 1418);
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.font = "600 18px Assistant, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText(`${modelName}  \u2022  Non-Penalty xGOT Shots`, 2336, 1418);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function renderCompView() {
    ensureFonts().then(() => drawDuelCardCanvas());
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // CANVAS TOOLTIP INTERACTIVITY & EXPORT HELPERS
  // =========================================================================
  function attachCanvasHover(canvasId, tooltipId, resolveHtmlFn) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    const tip = document.getElementById(tooltipId);
    if (!canvas || !tip) return;

    canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return;
      const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
      const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
      const cx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX;
      const cy = (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY;
      const html = resolveHtmlFn(cx, cy);
      if (!html) {
        tip.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }
      tip.innerHTML = html;
      tip.style.display = "block";
      const localX = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const localY = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const tipW = tip.offsetWidth || 180;
      const leftPos = (localX + 16 + tipW > rect.width) ? Math.max(8, localX - tipW - 14) : (localX + 14);
      tip.style.left = `${leftPos}px`;
      tip.style.top = `${Math.max(8, localY - 14)}px`;
    });

    canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      tip.style.display = "none";
    });
  }

  function downloadCanvasPng(canvasId, filename) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    if (!canvas) return;
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (!blob) return;
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = filename;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);
    }, "image/png");
  }

  function copyCanvasToClipboard(canvasId, toastId) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
    const toast = document.getElementById(toastId);
    if (!canvas || !toast) return;
    const showToast = (msg) => {
      toast.textContent = msg;
      setTimeout(() => { if (toast.textContent === msg) toast.textContent = ""; }, 2600);
    };
    if (!navigator.clipboard || typeof ClipboardItem === "undefined") {
      showToast("Use Download PNG (clipboard unsupported here)");
      return;
    }
    canvas.toBlob(async (blob) => {
      if (!blob) return;
      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ "image/png": blob })]);
        showToast("Copied PNG to clipboard");
      } catch (_err) {
        showToast("Clipboard blocked \u2014 use Download PNG");
      }
    }, "image/png");
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // TAB SWITCHING & INITIALIZATION
  // =========================================================================
  let currentTab = "post";
  let saveManuallyPicked = false;

  window.switchGkTab = function(tab) {
    currentTab = tab;
    document.getElementById("gk-panel-post").style.display = (tab === "post") ? "grid" : "none";
    document.getElementById("gk-panel-comp").style.display = (tab === "comp") ? "grid" : "none";
    document.getElementById("gk-panel-save").style.display = (tab === "save") ? "grid" : "none";

    document.getElementById("gk-tab-btn-post").classList.toggle("active", tab === "post");
    document.getElementById("gk-tab-btn-comp").classList.toggle("active", tab === "comp");
    document.getElementById("gk-tab-btn-save").classList.toggle("active", tab === "save");

    if (tab === "post") {
      renderPosteriorPlot();
    } else if (tab === "comp") {
      renderCompView();
    } else if (tab === "save") {
      if (!saveManuallyPicked) {
        const postLg = document.getElementById("league_filter").value;
        const postGk = document.getElementById("gk_select").value;
        if (postGk) {
          document.getElementById("save_league").value = postLg;
          comboRegistry["save_gk"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(postLg), postGk, 0);
        }
      }
      renderSaveProfile();
    }
  };

  function setupThemeGroup(groupId, onThemeChange) {
    const grp = document.getElementById(groupId);
    if (!grp) return;
    grp.querySelectorAll(".gk-seg-btn").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        grp.querySelectorAll(".gk-seg-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
        btn.classList.add("active");
        onThemeChange(btn.dataset.theme);
      });
    });
  }

  function initGkApp() {
    ["league_filter", "comp_league_a", "comp_league_b", "save_league"].forEach(id => populateLeagueSelect(id, "9134"));

    setupSearchableCombo("gk_select", () => renderPosteriorPlot());
    setupSearchableCombo("comp_gk_a", () => renderCompView());
    setupSearchableCombo("comp_gk_b", () => renderCompView());
    setupSearchableCombo("save_gk", () => { saveManuallyPicked = true; renderSaveProfile(); });

    const defA = pickDefaultKeeperId("9134", 0);
    const defB = pickDefaultKeeperId("9134", 1);

    comboRegistry["gk_select"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers("9134"), defA, 0);
    comboRegistry["comp_gk_a"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers("9134"), defA, 0);
    comboRegistry["comp_gk_b"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers("9134"), defB, 1);
    comboRegistry["save_gk"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers("9134"), defA, 0);

    document.getElementById("league_filter").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      const lv = e.target.value;
      comboRegistry["gk_select"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), pickDefaultKeeperId(lv, 0), 0);
      renderPosteriorPlot();
    });

    document.getElementById("comp_league_a").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      const lv = e.target.value;
      comboRegistry["comp_gk_a"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), pickDefaultKeeperId(lv, 0), 0);
      renderCompView();
    });

    document.getElementById("comp_league_b").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      const lv = e.target.value;
      comboRegistry["comp_gk_b"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), pickDefaultKeeperId(lv, 0), 1);
      renderCompView();
    });

    document.getElementById("save_league").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      saveManuallyPicked = true;
      const lv = e.target.value;
      comboRegistry["save_gk"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), pickDefaultKeeperId(lv, 0), 0);
      renderSaveProfile();
    });

    // Tab 1 Playback controls
    document.getElementById("post_replay_btn").addEventListener("click", () => startPostPlayback(true));
    document.getElementById("post_play_btn").addEventListener("click", () => startPostPlayback(false));
    document.getElementById("post_pause_btn").addEventListener("click", () => stopPostAnim());
    document.getElementById("post_final_btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      stopPostAnim();
      if (postAnimState.frames.length > 0) drawPosteriorFrameCanvas(postAnimState.frames.length - 1);
    });
    document.getElementById("post_scrub_range").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
      stopPostAnim();
      drawPosteriorFrameCanvas(Number(e.target.value));
    });

    document.getElementById("post_jump_save").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const lv = document.getElementById("league_filter").value;
      const kid = document.getElementById("gk_select").value;
      saveManuallyPicked = true;
      document.getElementById("save_league").value = lv;
      comboRegistry["save_gk"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), kid, 0);
      switchGkTab("save");
    });

    document.getElementById("download_post_png").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const k = keeperById.get(document.getElementById("gk_select").value);
      const fname = (k ? slugify(k.player_name) : "goalkeeper") + "_posterior.png";
      downloadCanvasPng("gk_posterior_canvas", fname);
    });

    // Tab 2 Controls
    document.getElementById("comp_swap_btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const lgA = document.getElementById("comp_league_a").value;
      const lgB = document.getElementById("comp_league_b").value;
      const idA = document.getElementById("comp_gk_a").value;
      const idB = document.getElementById("comp_gk_b").value;
      document.getElementById("comp_league_a").value = lgB;
      document.getElementById("comp_league_b").value = lgA;
      comboRegistry["comp_gk_a"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lgB), idB, 0);
      comboRegistry["comp_gk_b"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lgA), idA, 0);
      renderCompView();
    });

    setupThemeGroup("comp_theme_seg", (t) => {
      compTheme = t;
      saveTheme = t;
      document.querySelectorAll("#save_theme_seg .gk-seg-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.theme === t));
      drawDuelCardCanvas();
    });

    document.getElementById("download_duel_card").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const kA = keeperById.get(document.getElementById("comp_gk_a").value);
      const kB = keeperById.get(document.getElementById("comp_gk_b").value);
      const fname = `${slugify(kA?.player_name || "gk_a")}_vs_${slugify(kB?.player_name || "gk_b")}_duel.png`;
      downloadCanvasPng("comp_duel_canvas", fname);
    });

    document.getElementById("copy_duel_card").addEventListener("click", () => {
      copyCanvasToClipboard("comp_duel_canvas", "comp_copy_toast");
    });

    // Tab 3 Controls
    setupThemeGroup("save_theme_seg", (t) => {
      saveTheme = t;
      compTheme = t;
      document.querySelectorAll("#comp_theme_seg .gk-seg-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.theme === t));
      drawPlayerCardCanvas();
    });

    const benchSeg = document.getElementById("save_bench_seg");
    benchSeg.querySelectorAll(".gk-seg-btn").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        benchSeg.querySelectorAll(".gk-seg-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
        btn.classList.add("active");
        saveBench = btn.dataset.bench;
        drawPlayerCardCanvas();
      });
    });

    document.getElementById("download_save_dash").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const k = keeperById.get(document.getElementById("save_gk").value);
      const fname = `${slugify(k?.player_name || "goalkeeper")}_save_card.png`;
      downloadCanvasPng("save_player_canvas", fname);
    });

    document.getElementById("copy_save_card").addEventListener("click", () => {
      copyCanvasToClipboard("save_player_canvas", "save_copy_toast");
    });

    document.getElementById("save_compare_btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const lv = document.getElementById("save_league").value;
      const kid = document.getElementById("save_gk").value;
      document.getElementById("comp_league_a").value = lv;
      comboRegistry["comp_gk_a"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), kid, 0);
      const curB = document.getElementById("comp_gk_b").value;
      if (curB === kid) {
        const alt = getQualifiedCohort(lv).find(k => k.keeper_id !== kid);
        if (alt) {
          document.getElementById("comp_league_b").value = lv;
          comboRegistry["comp_gk_b"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lv), alt.keeper_id, 0);
        }
      }
      switchGkTab("comp");
    });

    document.getElementById("save_log_toggle").addEventListener("click", () => {
      const body = document.getElementById("save_log_body");
      const btn  = document.getElementById("save_log_toggle");
      const open = body.style.display === "none";
      body.style.display = open ? "block" : "none";
      btn.textContent = open ? "Hide Match Log" : "Show Match Log";
    });

    // Hover tooltips across all 3 high-DPI Canvases
    attachCanvasHover("gk_posterior_canvas", "post_canvas_tooltip", (cx, cy) => {
      const m = postAnimState.plotMeta;
      if (m && cx >= m.x0 && cx <= m.x1 && cy >= m.y0 && cy <= m.y1) {
        const xv = m.xMin + ((cx - m.x0) / (m.x1 - m.x0)) * (m.xMax - m.xMin);
        const pGreater = (1 - pnorm(xv, m.mu, Math.max(m.sd, 1e-6))) * 100;
        return `<b>Threshold: ${formatSigned(xv, 3)} GP/Shot</b><br>P(True Talent > ${formatSigned(xv, 3)}): <b>${pGreater.toFixed(1)}%</b>`;
      }
      return null;
    });

    attachCanvasHover("save_player_canvas", "save_canvas_tooltip", (cx, cy) => {
      for (let i = saveHitboxes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const h = saveHitboxes[i];
        if (cx >= h.x && cx <= h.x + h.w && cy >= h.y && cy <= h.y + h.h) return h.text;
      }
      if (savePlotMeta && cx >= savePlotMeta.x0 && cx <= savePlotMeta.x1 && cy >= savePlotMeta.y0 && cy <= savePlotMeta.y1) {
        const xv = savePlotMeta.xMin + ((cx - savePlotMeta.x0) / (savePlotMeta.x1 - savePlotMeta.x0)) * (savePlotMeta.xMax - savePlotMeta.xMin);
        const pGreater = (1 - pnorm(xv, savePlotMeta.mu, Math.max(savePlotMeta.sd, 1e-6))) * 100;
        return `<b>Talent Threshold: ${formatSigned(xv, 3)} GP/Shot</b><br>P(True Talent > ${formatSigned(xv, 3)}): <b>${pGreater.toFixed(1)}%</b>`;
      }
      return null;
    });

    attachCanvasHover("comp_duel_canvas", "comp_canvas_tooltip", (cx, cy) => {
      if (compPlotMeta && cx >= compPlotMeta.x0 && cx <= compPlotMeta.x1 && cy >= compPlotMeta.y0 && cy <= compPlotMeta.y1) {
        const xv = compPlotMeta.xMin + ((cx - compPlotMeta.x0) / (compPlotMeta.x1 - compPlotMeta.x0)) * (compPlotMeta.xMax - compPlotMeta.xMin);
        const pA = (1 - pnorm(xv, compPlotMeta.kA.mu, Math.max(compPlotMeta.kA.sd, 1e-6))) * 100;
        const pB = (1 - pnorm(xv, compPlotMeta.kB.mu, Math.max(compPlotMeta.kB.sd, 1e-6))) * 100;
        return `<b>Threshold: ${formatSigned(xv, 3)} GP/Shot</b><br>${escapeHtml(compPlotMeta.kA.player_name)}: ${pA.toFixed(1)}% above<br>${escapeHtml(compPlotMeta.kB.player_name)}: ${pB.toFixed(1)}% above`;
      }
      return null;
    });

    // Support URL hash / query deep links (e.g. ?tab=save or #save)
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const reqTab = (params.get("tab") || window.location.hash.replace("#", "") || "").toLowerCase();
    const reqKeeper = params.get("keeper");
    if (reqKeeper && keeperById.has(reqKeeper)) {
      const k = keeperById.get(reqKeeper);
      const lg = String(k.primary_league_id);
      const lgChoice = LEAGUE_CHOICES.some(c => c.value === lg) ? lg : "all";
      ["league_filter", "save_league", "comp_league_a"].forEach(id => {
        document.getElementById(id).value = lgChoice;
      });
      comboRegistry["gk_select"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lgChoice), reqKeeper, 0);
      comboRegistry["save_gk"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lgChoice), reqKeeper, 0);
      comboRegistry["comp_gk_a"].setItems(getFilteredKeepers(lgChoice), reqKeeper, 0);
      saveManuallyPicked = true;
    }

    if (reqTab === "save" || reqTab === "comp" || reqTab === "post") {
      switchGkTab(reqTab);
    } else {
      renderPosteriorPlot();
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initGkApp);
  } else {
    initGkApp();
  }
})();
</script>
```
